--思维中价退费情况
WITH detail AS
(
	SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
	        s.end_class_dt,
	        a.user_id,
  a.lesson_id,
	        MAX(a.stage_name) AS stage_name,
	        MAX(CASE WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') AND accountid is null or accountid = '' THEN '无账户' WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') AND accountid IN ('1822030030407690','1822027034104842','1822030131404891','1761605098022045','1761242332601421','1768215457237069','1773641570409549','1738048746778632','1786225457446027') THEN '拼接账户' WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') THEN '常规账户' ELSE '其他' END) AS account_type,
	        MAX(age_buy_lesson_type) AS age_buy_lesson_type,
	        MAX(a.pay_dt) AS pay_dt,
	        MAX(s.parent_semester_id) AS parent_semester_id,
  max(s.semester_tag) as semester_tag,
	        MAX(refund_dt) AS refund_dt,
	        MIN(if(is_finish_end = 1,1,0)) AS is_finish_end,
	        MAX(if(m.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_after_season,
	        MAX(if(n.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_before_season,
	        MAX(validation) AS validation,
	        MAX(if(is_gou = 1,1,0)) AS is_gou,
	        MAX(j.end_class_dt) AS pre_end_class_dt,
	        MAX(if(f.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_live
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        semesterid,
      a.lesson_id,
		        start_class_dt,
		        order_id,
		        stage_name,
		        parent_order_id,
		        subject_id,
		        keyfrom,
		        refund_dt,
		        refund_tp,
		        pay_dt,
		        pay_tp,
		        age_buy_lesson_type,
		        ad_channel,
		        classid,
		        teacherid,
		        ldap,
		        is_finish_end,
		        is_season
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        order_id,
          a.lesson_id,
			        stage_name,
			        pay_dt,
			        pay_tp,
			        subject_id,
			        parent_order_id,
			        keyfrom,
			        order_status,
			        start_class_dt,
			        age_buy_lesson_type,
			        ad_channel,
			        semesterid,
			        classid,
			        teacherid,
			        ldap,
			        refund_dt,
			        refund_tp,
			        is_finish_end,
			        is_season,
			        dt,
			        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.order_id ORDER BY  dt DESC) AS rk
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        order_id,
              a.lesson_id,
				        stage_name,
				        pay_dt,
				        pay_tp,
				        subject_id,
				        parent_order_id,
				        keyfrom,
				        order_status,
				        start_class_dt,
				        age_buy_lesson_type,
				        ad_channel,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        refund_dt,
				        refund_tp
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  a.user_id,
					        a.order_id,
                  a.lesson_id,
					        stage_name,
					        a.pay_dt,
					        a.pay_tp,
					        a.subject_id,
					        a.parent_order_id,
					        a.keyfrom,
					        a.order_status,
					        a.start_class_dt,
					        a.age_buy_lesson_type,
					        a.ad_channel,
					        b.semesterid,
					        classid,
					        teacherid,
					        ldap,
					        if(c.refund_dt is not null,c.refund_dt,null) AS refund_dt,
					        if(c.refund_tp is not null,c.refund_tp,null) AS refund_tp,
					        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.user_id,a.start_class_dt,a.subject_id ORDER BY  coalesce(c.refund_dt,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  a.user_id,
						        a.order_id,
                      a.lesson_id,
						        a.pay_dt,
						        a.pay_tp,
						        a.subject_id,
						        a.parent_order_id,
						        a.keyfrom,
						        a.order_status,
						        a.refund_related_weekcount,
						        a.start_class_dt,
						        age_buy_lesson_type,
						        ad_channel,
						        stage_name
						FROM
						(
							SELECT  user_id,
							        order_id,
							        pay_dt,
							        pay_tp,
							        subject_id,
							        parent_order_id,
							        keyfrom,
							        order_status,
							        refund_related_weekcount,
							        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
							        lesson_id,
							        stage_name
							FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
							WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
							AND subject_id = 2
							AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}} 
						)a
						JOIN
						(
							SELECT  user_id,
							        order_id,
							        CASE WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 0 AND age_buy_lesson < 2 THEN '0-2岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 2 AND age_buy_lesson < 3 THEN '2-3岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 3 AND age_buy_lesson < 4 THEN '3-4岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 4 AND age_buy_lesson < 5 THEN '4-5岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 5 AND age_buy_lesson < 6 THEN '5-6岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 6 AND age_buy_lesson < 7 THEN '6-7岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 7 AND age_buy_lesson < 8 THEN '7-8岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 8 AND age_buy_lesson < 9 THEN '8-9岁'
							             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 9 THEN '9岁以上'  ELSE '未设置' END AS age_buy_lesson_type,
							        ad_channel
							FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_trade_try_double_order_from_info_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价')
						)b
						ON a.order_id = b.order_id
						LEFT JOIN
						(
							SELECT  parent_order_id,
							        MAX(if(subject_id = 1,1,0)) AS has_eng,
							        MAX(if(subject_id = 2,1,0)) AS has_math
							FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
							AND order_status >= 2
							AND order_id != parent_order_id -- 父订单和子订单不是同一个订单
							GROUP BY  parent_order_id
						)c
						ON a.parent_order_id = c.parent_order_id
						WHERE (has_eng is null or has_eng = 0) 
					) a
					LEFT JOIN
					( -- 订单 表
						SELECT  b.*,
						        orderid,
						        ldap
						FROM
						(
							SELECT  orderid,
							        userid,
							        id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
							WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
						) a
						JOIN
						( -- 分班 表
							SELECT  userid,
							        semesterid,
							        classid,
							        teacherid,
							        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
							        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND lessonid IN ('70','830')
							AND type = 1
							AND status <> 3 
						) b
						ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
						LEFT JOIN
						(
							SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
							        tf.key AS teacherid
							FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
							WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
						)c
						ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
					) b
					ON a.order_id = b.orderid
					LEFT JOIN
					( -- 退款 表
						SELECT  order_id,
						        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
						        refund_tp,
						        refundment_type_name
						FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND refund_status_code = 2 -- 成功
						AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
					) c
					ON a.order_id = c.order_id
				)a
				WHERE rk = 1 
			)a
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  user_id AS userid,
				        order_id AS orderid,
				        is_finish_end_class AS is_finish_end,
				        is_renewal AS is_season,
				        dt,
				        end_class_dt
				FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
				WHERE dt BETWEEN date_sub(start_class_dt, 21) AND date_add(end_class_dt, 14)
				AND {{start_class_dt}} 
              AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			) d
			ON a.order_id = d.orderid AND refund_dt is not null AND d.dt <= a.refund_dt
		)a
		WHERE rk = 1 
	)a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  semester_id,
		        parent_semester_id,
		        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
		        is_bundled,
		        subject_id AS subject,
		        end_class_dt,
		        lesson_id
		FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	) s
	ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,
		        first_refund_dt,
		        refund_related_weekcount
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        order_id,
			        pay_dt,
			        subject_id,
			        pay_tp,
			        first_refund_tp,
			        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
			        refund_related_weekcount
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
			WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND semester_type IN ('season')
			AND order_status >= 2 
		) a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  renewal_order_id AS renewal_orderid
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND is_renewal = 1 
          AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		)b
		ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
		WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
	)m
	ON a.user_id = m.user_id AND a.subject_id = m.subject_id AND m.pay_tp > a.refund_tp AND a.refund_tp is not null AND m.pay_dt <= date_add(s.end_class_dt, 7) AND (m.first_refund_tp is null or m.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or m.first_refund_dt > date_add(s.end_class_dt, 14))
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  userid,
		        classid,
		        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		GROUP BY  userid,
		          classid
	)t
	ON a.user_id = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,
		        first_refund_dt,
		        refund_related_weekcount
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        order_id,
			        pay_dt,
			        subject_id,
			        pay_tp,
			        first_refund_tp,
			        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
			        refund_related_weekcount
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
			WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND semester_type IN ('season')
			AND order_status >= 2 
		) a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  renewal_order_id AS renewal_orderid
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND is_renewal = 1 
          AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		)b
		ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
		WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
	)n
	ON a.user_id = n.user_id AND a.subject_id = n.subject_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND a.refund_tp is not null AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(s.end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(s.end_class_dt, 14))
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  userid,
		        ldap,
		        from_unixtime(int(createdtime/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS create_dt,
		        MAX(validation) AS validation,
		        MAX(1) AS is_gou
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_task_interview_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		GROUP BY  userid,
		          ldap,
		          from_unixtime(int(createdtime/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd')
	)e
	ON a.user_id = e.userid AND a.ldap = e.ldap AND a.refund_dt is not null AND e.create_dt <= a.refund_dt AND create_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 14)
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        teacher_ldap,
		        from_unixtime(int(start_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_dt
		FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_service_live_user_class_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND sky_episode_business_type IN ('2', '7')
		AND CAST(first_enter_time AS BIGINT) > 0
		AND CAST(valid_watch_time AS BIGINT) > 0 
	)f
	ON a.user_id = f.user_id AND a.ldap = f.teacher_ldap AND f.start_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 28) AND f.start_dt <= a.refund_dt AND a.refund_dt is not null
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  distinct outorderid,
		        outoriginorderid,
		        orderid
		FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_growth_thirdapi_third_order_tuomin_da ---外部订单信息
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	)g
	ON a.order_id = g.orderid
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  toto.outerorderid,
		        adgroupid,
		        adgroupname,
		        accountid,
		        source
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  outerorderid,
			        applyaccountid
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_promotion_data_aggregate_ad_outer_order_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			GROUP BY  outerorderid,
			          applyaccountid
		)toto
		JOIN
		(
			SELECT  adgroupid,
			        adgroupname,
			        accountid,
			        source
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_commerce_marketing_ad_base_info_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			GROUP BY  adgroupid,
			          accountid,
			          source,
			          adgroupname
		)p
		ON toto.applyaccountid = p.adgroupid
	)h
	ON g.outoriginorderid = h.outerorderid
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        semester_type,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_name,
		        subject_id
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND semester_type IN ('season', 'try_double', 'fourweek')
		AND order_status = 2 
	)i
	ON a.user_id = i.user_id AND i.pay_dt < a.pay_dt
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  'try_double' AS semester_type,
		        order_id,
		        user_id,
		        MAX(end_class_dt) AS end_class_dt
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
      AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		GROUP BY  order_id,
		          user_id
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  'season' AS semester_type,
		        order_id,
		        user_id,
		        MAX(end_class_dt) AS end_class_dt
		FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_course_season_user_lesson_receipt_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		GROUP BY  order_id,
		          user_id
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  'fourweek' AS semester_type,
		        order_id,
		        user_id,
		        MAX(end_class_dt) AS end_class_dt
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_fourweek_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		GROUP BY  order_id,
		          user_id
	)j
	ON i.order_id = j.order_id AND i.semester_type = j.semester_type
	GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
	          s.end_class_dt,
	          a.user_id,
  a.lesson_id
) 
--退费前发生有效沟通行为的占比、退费前发生老师直播行为的占比、退费用户退前的完课率、退费前续报占比（*订单维度退费发生时间和系统课退费发生时间）
SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
a.mode,
        a.stage_name,
        a.account_type,
        a.age_buy_lesson_type,
        a.duanke_type,
        refunt_dt,
        order_cnt,
        b.tui_cnt/order_cnt AS all_tui_rate,
        a.tui_cnt/order_cnt AS tui_rate,
        gou_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS gou_rate,
        valid_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS valid_rate,
        live_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS live_rate,
        finish_end_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS finish_end_rate,
        before_season_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS before_season_rate,
        after_season_cnt/a.tui_cnt AS after_season_rate
FROM
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
  coalesce(case when (semester_tag like '%A%' or lesson_id=830) then '独立分班' else '非独立分班' end,'total_count') AS mode,
	        coalesce(stage_name,'total_count') AS stage_name,
	        coalesce(account_type,'total_count') AS account_type,
	        coalesce(age_buy_lesson_type,'total_count') AS age_buy_lesson_type,
	        coalesce(CASE WHEN pre_end_class_dt is null or pre_end_class_dt = '' THEN '新用户' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) BETWEEN 30 AND 60 THEN '断课1-2个月' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) BETWEEN 60 AND 90 THEN '断课2-3个月' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) BETWEEN 90 AND 180 THEN '断课3-6个月' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) BETWEEN 180 AND 365 THEN '断课6-12个月' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) BETWEEN 365 AND 365*2 THEN '断课1-2年' WHEN DATEDIFF(pay_dt,pre_end_class_dt) > 365*2 THEN '断课2年以上' ELSE '其他' END,'total_count') AS duanke_type,
	        CASE WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt <= date_sub(start_class_dt,14) THEN 'W-1D1'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,13) THEN 'W-1D2'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,12) THEN 'W-1D3'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,11) THEN 'W-1D4'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,10) THEN 'W-1D5'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,9) THEN 'W-1D6'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,8) THEN 'W-1D7'
	             WHEN parent_semester_id is null AND refund_dt >= date_sub(start_class_dt,7) THEN '分班前-W0D1'
	             WHEN refund_dt <= date_sub(start_class_dt,7) THEN '分班后-W0D1'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W0D2'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W0D3'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W0D4'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W0D5'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W0D6'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W0D7'
	             WHEN refund_dt = start_class_dt THEN 'W1D1'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W1D2'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W1D3'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W1D4'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W1D5'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W1D6'
	             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W1D7'
	             WHEN refund_dt > date_add(start_class_dt,6) AND refund_dt <= END_class_dt THEN 'W2'
	             WHEN refund_dt > END_class_dt AND refund_dt <= date_add(end_class_dt,7) THEN 'W3'
	             WHEN refund_dt > date_add(end_class_dt,7) THEN 'W4'  ELSE '其他' END AS refunt_dt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS tui_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_gou = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS gou_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(validation = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS valid_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_live = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS live_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_finish_end = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS finish_end_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_before_season = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS before_season_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_after_season = 1 AND refund_dt is not null,user_id,null)) AS after_season_cnt
	FROM detail
	WHERE refund_dt is not null

file_content:
WITH phone AS
(
	SELECT  semesterid,
	        ldap,
	        userid,
	        created_monday,
	        created_dt,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(callendstatus = '1' AND calltype IN ('2','4','5'),c.callid,null)),0) AS suc_outcall_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(callendstatus != '1' AND calltype IN ('2','4','5'),c.callid,null)),0) AS def_outcall_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '2',c.callid,null)),0) AS sys_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '4',c.callid,null)),0) AS gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '5',c.callid,null)),0) AS weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  interview_id,
		        ldap,
		        userid,
		        semesterid
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_user_mentor_interview_try_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	)a
	JOIN dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_work_interview_call_relation_da b
	ON a.interview_id = b.interviewid AND b.dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	JOIN
	(
		SELECT  callid,
		        callendstatus,
		        callstatus,
		        calltype,
		        from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS created_time,
		        hour(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS hour_part,
		        minute(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS minute_part,
		        second(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS second_part,
		        date_sub(next_day(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd'),'MO'),7) AS created_monday,
		        from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS created_dt
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  callid,
			        callstatus,
			        callendstatus,
			        calltype,
			        CASE WHEN length(cast(starttime AS string)) = 13 THEN cast(starttime AS bigint) / 1000
			             WHEN length(cast(starttime AS string)) = 10 THEN cast(starttime AS bigint)  ELSE null END AS starttime
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_call_mentor_call_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND calltype IN ('2', '4', '5') 
		)a
		WHERE {{date_sub(next_day(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'MO'), 7) AS created_monday}} 
	)c
	ON b.callid = c.callid
	GROUP BY  semesterid,
	          ldap,
	          userid,
	          created_monday,
	          created_dt
) , weixin AS
(
	SELECT  ldap,
	        userid,
	        created_monday,
	        created_dt,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(callendstatus = '1' AND calltype IN ('2','4','5'),a.callid,null)),0) AS suc_outcall_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(callendstatus != '1' AND calltype IN ('2','4','5'),a.callid,null)),0) AS def_outcall_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '2',a.callid,null)),0) AS sys_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '4',a.callid,null)),0) AS gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND ((minute_part > 0) OR (minute_part = 0 AND second_part >= 5))) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)) AND calltype = '5',a.callid,null)),0) AS weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  ldap,
		        userid,
		        a.callid,
		        callstatus,
		        callendstatus,
		        calltype,
		        from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS created_time,
		        hour(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS hour_part,
		        minute(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS minute_part,
		        second(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS second_part,
		        date_sub(next_day(from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd'),'MO'),7) AS created_monday,
		        from_unixtime(cast(starttime AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS created_dt
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  callid,
			        callstatus,
			        calltype,
			        callendstatus,
			        ldap,
			        dstphone,
			        CASE WHEN length(cast(starttime AS string)) = 13 THEN cast(starttime AS bigint) / 1000
			             WHEN length(cast(starttime AS string)) = 10 THEN cast(starttime AS bigint)  ELSE null END AS starttime
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_call_mentor_call_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND calltype IN ('2', '4', '5') 
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  userid,
			        phone
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_site_user_reg_profile_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
		)b
		ON a.dstphone = b.phone
		LEFT JOIN dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_work_interview_call_relation_da c
		ON a.callid = c.callid AND c.dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		WHERE c.callid is null 
	)a
	WHERE {{created_monday}}
	GROUP BY  ldap,
	          userid,
	          created_monday,
	          created_dt
) , wechat AS
(
	SELECT  sender_userid,
	        receiver_userid,
	        wechat_dt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(((hour_part = 22 AND minute_part >=11) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)),rowkey,null)) AS news_over_num
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  sender_userid,
		        receiver_userid,
		        created_tp,
		        to_date(from_unixtime(int(created_tp/1000))) AS wechat_dt,
		        hour(from_unixtime(cast(created_tp/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS hour_part,
		        minute(from_unixtime(cast(created_tp/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS minute_part,
		        second(from_unixtime(cast(created_tp/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) AS second_part,
		        rowkey,
		        content
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_service_emon_chat_message_di
		WHERE {{date_sub(next_day(dt, 'MO'), 7) AS created_monday}}
		AND sender_type = 'teacher'
		AND chat_type = '1' 
	)a
	GROUP BY  sender_userid,
	          receiver_userid,
	          wechat_dt
) , task AS
(
	SELECT  a.fromwechatid,
	        userid,
	        created_monday,
	        send_dt,
	        MAX(if(qunfa_type='定时发送' and ((hour_part = 22 AND minute_part >=11) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)),1,0)) AS is_task_dingshi,
	        MAX(if(qunfa_type='立即发送' and ((hour_part = 22 AND minute_part >=11) OR hour_part IN (23,0,1,2,3,4)),1,0)) AS is_task_liji
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  distinct id,
		        fromwechatid,
		        date_sub(next_day(date(IF(scheduletime > 0,from_unixtime(CAST(scheduletime / 1000 AS bigint)),CAST(dbctime AS timestamp))),'MO'),7) AS created_monday,
		        date(IF(scheduletime > 0,from_unixtime(CAST(scheduletime / 1000 AS bigint)),CAST(dbctime AS timestamp))) AS send_dt,
		        hour(if(scheduletime > 0,from_unixtime(cast(scheduletime/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),dbctime)) AS hour_part,
		        minute(if(scheduletime > 0,from_unixtime(cast(scheduletime/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),dbctime)) AS minute_part,
		        second(if(scheduletime > 0,from_unixtime(cast(scheduletime/1000 AS BIGINT),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),dbctime)) AS second_part,
                CASE WHEN scheduleTime > 0 THEN '定时发送'
	            	 WHEN scheduleTime <= 0 THEN '立即发送' END AS qunfa_type
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_dora_task_v2_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND status = 'SUCCESS'
		AND type IN ('GROUPNOTICE', 'SINGLECHAT', 'SINGLECHAT_1V1')
		AND {{date_sub(next_day(date(IF(scheduletime > 0, from_unixtime(CAST(scheduletime / 1000 AS bigint)), CAST(dbctime AS timestamp))), 'MO'), 7) AS created_monday}} 
	)a
	JOIN
	(
		SELECT  taskid,
		        fromwechatid,
		        userid
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_dora_command_v2_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND status = 'SUCCESS' 
	)b
	ON a.id = b.taskid AND a.fromwechatid = b.fromwechatid
	GROUP BY  a.fromwechatid,
	          userid,
	          created_monday,
	          send_dt
), date_offsets AS
(
	SELECT  0 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  1 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  2 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  3 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  4 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  5 AS offset
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  6 AS offset
), dt_info AS
(
	SELECT  distinct created_monday,
	        date_add(created_monday,offset) AS week_date
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  distinct created_monday
		FROM phone
	) a
	JOIN date_offsets b
	ON 1 = 1
)
SELECT  ldap,
        chinese_name,
        mentor_org_city,
        team_leader_ldap,
        team_leader_name,
        district_leader_ldap,
        district_leader_name,
        subject,
        userid,
        phone,
        created_dt,
        week_dt,
        freq_type,
        suc_outcall_num,
        suc_outcall_num_minus2,
        def_outcall_num,
        def_outcall_num_minus3,
        timeline_type,
        sys_outcall_over_num,
        weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,
        gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
        news_over_num,
        is_task_dingshi,
        is_task_liji,
        is_daida,
        ldap_all
FROM
(
	SELECT  a.ldap,
	        mentor_ldap,
	        chinese_name,
	        mentor_org_city,
	        team_leader_ldap,
	        team_leader_name,
	        district_leader_ldap,
	        district_leader_name,
	        a.subject,
	        a.userid,
	        phone,
	        a.created_dt,
	        a.week_dt,
	        CASE WHEN coalesce(suc_outcall_num,0) <= 2 AND coalesce(def_outcall_num,0) <= 3 THEN '1'  ELSE '0' END AS freq_type,
	        coalesce(suc_outcall_num,0) AS suc_outcall_num,
	        if(coalesce(suc_outcall_num,0) > 2,coalesce(suc_outcall_num,0)-2,0) AS suc_outcall_num_minus2,
	        coalesce(def_outcall_num,0) AS def_outcall_num,
	        if(coalesce(def_outcall_num,0) > 3,coalesce(def_outcall_num,0)-3,0) AS def_outcall_num_minus3,
	        CASE WHEN coalesce(sys_outcall_over_num,0) = 0 AND coalesce(weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,0) = 0 AND coalesce(gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,0) = 0 AND coalesce(news_over_num,0) = 0 AND coalesce(is_task_dingshi,0) = 0 AND coalesce(is_task_liji,0) = 0 THEN '1'  ELSE '0' END AS timeline_type,
	        coalesce(sys_outcall_over_num,0) AS sys_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,0) AS weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,0) AS gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
	        coalesce(news_over_num,0) AS news_over_num,
	        is_daida,
	        ldap_all,
	        coalesce(is_task_dingshi,0) AS is_task_dingshi,
	        coalesce(is_task_liji,0) AS is_task_liji
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  ldap,
		        subject,
		        semesterid,
		        userid,
		        created_dt,
		        week_dt,
		        SUM(suc_outcall_num) AS suc_outcall_num,
		        SUM(def_outcall_num) AS def_outcall_num,
		        SUM(sys_outcall_over_num) AS sys_outcall_over_num,
		        SUM(weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num) AS weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,
		        SUM(gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num) AS gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
		        SUM(news_over_num) AS news_over_num,
		        MAX(is_task_dingshi) AS is_task_dingshi,
		        MAX(is_task_liji) AS is_task_liji,
		        MAX(is_daida) AS is_daida,
		        concat_ws(',',collect_set(daida_ldap)) AS ldap_all
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  a.ldap,
			        a.subject,
			        a.semesterid,
			        a.userid,
			        b.week_date AS created_dt,
			        b.created_monday AS week_dt,
			        c.suc_outcall_num+d.suc_outcall_num AS suc_outcall_num,
			        c.def_outcall_num+d.def_outcall_num AS def_outcall_num,
			        c.sys_outcall_over_num+d.sys_outcall_over_num AS sys_outcall_over_num,
			        c.weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num+d.weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num AS weixinyuyin_outcall_over_num,
			        c.gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num+d.gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num AS gongzuodianhua_outcall_over_num,
			        coalesce(news_over_num,0) AS news_over_num,
			        coalesce(is_task_dingshi,0) AS is_task_dingshi,
			        coalesce(is_task_liji,0) AS is_task_liji,
			        if(c.ldap <> a.ldap,1,0) AS is_daida,
			        if(c.ldap <> a.ldap,c.ldap,null) AS daida_ldap
			FROM
			(--主 表
				SELECT  *
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  start_class_dt,
					        CASE WHEN subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 126 THEN '英语双周课'
					             WHEN subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 800 THEN '英语中价课'
					             WHEN subject_id = 2 THEN '思维双周课'
					             WHEN subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读双周课' END AS subject,
					        user_id AS userid,
					        semester_id AS semesterid,
					        teacher_ldap AS ldap
					FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
					AND is_bundled = '单带'
					AND semester_label != '虚拟' 
					UNION ALL
					SELECT  start_class_dt,
					        subject,
					        userid,
					        parent_semester_id AS semesterid,
					        ldap
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  start_class_dt,
						        '思英模式' subject,
						        user_id AS userid,
						        teacher_ldap AS ldap,
						        MAX(semester_id) AS semesterid
						FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
						AND is_bundled = '联带'
						AND semester_label != '虚拟'
						GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
						          user_id,
						          teacher_ldap
					) a
					JOIN
					( --找到主学科semesteri d
						SELECT  semester_id,
						        parent_semester_id
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
					) s
					ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
					UNION ALL
					SELECT  start_class_dt,
					        '单周课' AS subject,
					        user_id AS userid,
					        semester_id AS semesterid,
					        teacher_ldap AS ldap
					FROM dw_dws.dws_conan_user_try_refer_user_quality_detail_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
					AND subject_id = '1' 
					UNION ALL
					SELECT  regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
					        CASE WHEN subject_id = 4 THEN '美术'
					             WHEN subject_id = 5 THEN '写字'
					             WHEN subject_id = 7 THEN '音乐'
					             WHEN subject_id = 8 THEN '科学' END AS subject,
					        user_id AS userid,
					        semester_id AS semesterid,
					        teacher_ldap AS ldap
					FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
				)a
				WHERE 1 = 1
				AND {{start_class_dt}} 
			)a
			JOIN dt_info b
			ON b.created_monday BETWEEN date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 7) AND date_add(a.start_class_dt, 27)
			LEFT JOIN phone c
			ON a.userid = c.userid AND a.semesterid = c.semesterid AND c.created_dt = b.week_date
			LEFT JOIN weixin d
			ON a.userid = d.userid AND a.ldap = d.ldap AND d.created_dt = b.week_date
			LEFT JOIN wechat e
			ON a.ldap = e.sender_userid AND a.userid = e.receiver_userid AND b.week_date = e.wechat_dt
			LEFT JOIN task f
			ON a.ldap = f.fromwechatid AND b.week_date = f.send_dt AND a.userid = f.userid
		) a
		GROUP BY  ldap,
		          subject,
		          semesterid,
		          userid,
		          created_dt,
		          week_dt
	)a
	LEFT JOIN
	(--老师信息 表
		SELECT  mentor_ldap,
		        chinese_name,
		        mentor_org_city,
		        team_leader_ldap,
		        team_leader_name,
		        district_leader_ldap,
		        district_leader_name

		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		GROUP BY  mentor_ldap,

		          mentor_org_city,
		          team_leader_ldap,
		          team_leader_name,
		          district_leader_ldap,
		          district_leader_name
	) teacher
	ON a.ldap = teacher.mentor_ldap
  LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  userid,
		        phone
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_site_user_reg_profile_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	)user
	ON a.userid = user.userid
	GROUP BY  a.ldap,

	          team_leader_name,
	          district_leader_ldap,

) a

,count(distinct if(is_finish_both = 1 and is_season=1, user_quality.orderid, null)) as `两科目完课且续报订单数`

file_content:
--用户粒度课前是否退费、是否被1v1覆盖、参课沟通时长 
--是否被参课沟通、是否被1v1覆盖拆成「建课」和「有效」两个
WITH refund_base AS
(
	SELECT  a.userid,
	        a.orderid,
	        start_class_dt,
	        semesterid,
	        classid,
	        teacherid,
	        ldap,
	        refund_dt,
	        refund_tp,
	        is_finish_end_class,
	        is_attend_first_day
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.userid,
		        a.orderid,
		        start_class_dt,
		        semesterid,
		        classid,
		        teacherid,
		        ldap,
		        refund_dt,
		        refund_tp,
		        is_finish_end_class,
		        is_attend_first_day,
		        dt,
		        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.orderid ORDER BY  dt DESC) AS rk
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  userid,
			        orderid,
			        start_class_dt,
			        semesterid,
			        classid,
			        teacherid,
			        ldap,
			        refund_dt,
			        refund_tp
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  a.userid,
				        a.orderid,
				        a.start_class_dt,
				        a.semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        if(b.refund_dt is not null,b.refund_dt,null) AS refund_dt,
				        if(b.refund_tp is not null,b.refund_tp,null) AS refund_tp,
				        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.userid,a.start_class_dt ORDER BY  coalesce(b.refund_dt,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  b.*,
					        orderid,
					        ldap
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  orderid,
						        userid,
						        id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
						WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
					) a
					JOIN
					( -- 分班 表
						SELECT  userid,
						        semesterid,
						        classid,
						        teacherid,
						        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
						        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND lessonid IN ('800')
						AND type = 1
						AND status <> 3
						AND {{from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt}} 
					) b
					ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
						        tf.key AS teacherid
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
					)c
					ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
				)a
				LEFT JOIN
				( -- 退款 表
					SELECT  order_id,
					        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
					        refund_tp,
					        refundment_type_name
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
					AND refund_status_code = 2 -- 成功
					AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
				) b
				ON a.orderid = b.order_id
			)a
			WHERE rk = 1
			AND refund_tp is not null 
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id AS userid,
			        order_id AS orderid,
			        if(received_mission_num = 8 AND received_mission_num = end_finished_mission_num,1,0) AS is_finish_end_class,
			        is_attend_first_day,
			        dt
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt BETWEEN start_class_dt AND end_class_dt
			AND {{start_class_dt}} 
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		) d
		ON a.orderid = d.orderid AND d.dt <= a.refund_dt
	) a
	WHERE rk = 1 
) , detail AS
(
	SELECT  a.*,
	        third_channel
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  '未退费' AS user_type,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        stage_name,
		        a.userid,
		        a.order_id,
		        a.teacher_ldap AS ldap,
		        is_canke,
		        is_canke_valid,
		        canke_duration,
		        SUM(valid_watch_time) AS valid_watch_time,
		        MAX(if(b.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_send_1v1,
		        MAX(if(b.user_id is not null AND CAST(b.first_enter_time AS BIGINT) > 0 AND CAST(b.valid_watch_time AS BIGINT) > 0,1,0)) AS is_enter_1v1,
		        MAX(is_renewal) AS is_renewal,
		        MAX(is_attend_first_day) AS is_attend_first_day,
		        MAX(is_finish_end_class) AS is_finish_end_class
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  start_class_dt,
			        user_id AS userid,
			        stage_name,
			        semester_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        order_id,
			        is_renewal,
			        is_attend_first_day,
			        is_finish_end_class
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND subject_id = 1
			AND lesson_id = 800
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND {{start_class_dt}} 
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        first_enter_time,
			        valid_watch_time,
			        from_unixtime(int(start_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_dt,
			        sky_episode_business_type
			FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_service_live_user_class_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND sky_episode_business_type IN ('2', '7') 
		)b
		ON a.userid = b.user_id AND a.teacher_ldap = b.teacher_ldap AND b.start_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 28) AND b.start_dt <= date_add(a.start_class_dt, 14)
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  userid AS user_id,
			        semesterid,
			        MAX(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通',1,0)) AS is_canke,
			        MAX(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通' AND validation = 1,1,0)) AS is_canke_valid,
			        SUM(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通',duration,0)) AS canke_duration
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_user_mentor_interview_try_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			GROUP BY  userid,
			          semesterid
		)c
		ON a.userid = c.user_id AND a.semester_id = c.semesterid
		GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
		          a.userid,
		          a.order_id,
		          a.teacher_ldap,
		          stage_name,
		          is_canke,
		          is_canke_valid,
		          canke_duration
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  CASE WHEN refund_dt <= date_sub(a.start_class_dt,8) THEN 'W-1之前'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,7) THEN 'W0D1'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W0D2'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W0D3'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W0D4'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W0D5'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W0D6'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W0D7'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,0) THEN 'W1D1'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W1D2'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W1D3'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W1D4'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W1D5'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W1D6'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W1D7'
		             WHEN refund_dt >= date_add(a.start_class_dt,7) THEN 'W2之后' END AS user_type,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        stage_name,
		        a.userid,
		        a.orderid AS order_id,
		        a.ldap,
		        MAX(if(is_canke = 1,1,0)) AS is_canke,
		        MAX(if(is_canke_valid = 1,1,0)) AS is_canke_valid,
		        SUM(if(canke_duration > 0,canke_duration,0)) AS canke_duration,
		        MAX(if(valid_watch_time > 0,canke_duration,0) ) AS valid_watch_time,
		        MAX(if(is_send_1v1 = 1,1,0)) AS is_send_1v1,
		        MAX(if(is_enter_1v1 = 1,1,0)) AS is_enter_1v1,
		        MAX(if(n.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_renewal,
		        MAX(is_attend_first_day) AS is_attend_first_day,
		        MAX(is_finish_end_class) AS is_finish_end_class
		FROM refund_base a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  semester_id,
			        start_stage_name AS stage_name,
			        end_class_dt
			FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND subject_id = 1
			AND lesson_id = 800 
		) s
		ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  userid,
			        ldap,
			        from_unixtime(int(created_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS create_dt,
			        MAX(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通',1,0)) AS is_canke,
			        MAX(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通' AND validation = 1,1,0)) AS is_canke_valid,
			        SUM(if(communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通',duration,0)) AS canke_duration
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_user_mentor_interview_try_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND subject = 1
			GROUP BY  userid,
			          ldap,
			          from_unixtime(int(created_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd')
		)e
		ON a.userid = e.userid AND a.ldap = e.ldap AND e.create_dt <= a.refund_dt AND create_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 14)
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  a.userid,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        SUM(valid_watch_time) AS valid_watch_time,
			        MAX(if(b.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_send_1v1,
			        MAX(if(b.user_id is not null AND CAST(b.first_enter_time AS BIGINT) > 0 AND CAST(b.valid_watch_time AS BIGINT) > 0,1,0)) AS is_enter_1v1
			FROM refund_base a
			JOIN
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        teacher_ldap,
				        from_unixtime(int(start_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_dt,
				        first_enter_time,
				        valid_watch_time
				FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_service_live_user_class_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				AND sky_episode_business_type IN ('2', '7') 
			)b
			ON a.userid = b.user_id AND a.ldap = b.teacher_ldap AND b.start_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 28) AND b.start_dt <= a.refund_dt
			GROUP BY  a.userid,
			          a.start_class_dt
		)f
		ON a.userid = f.userid AND a.start_class_dt = f.start_class_dt
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  userid,
			        classid,
			        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			GROUP BY  userid,
			          classid
		)t
		ON a.userid = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        order_id,
			        pay_dt,
			        subject_id,
			        pay_tp,
			        first_refund_tp,
			        first_refund_dt,
			        refund_related_weekcount
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        order_id,
				        pay_dt,
				        subject_id,
				        pay_tp,
				        first_refund_tp,
				        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
				        refund_related_weekcount
				FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
				WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
				AND semester_type IN ('season')
				AND order_status >= 2
				AND subject_id = 1 
			) a
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  renewal_order_id AS renewal_orderid
				FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				AND is_renewal = 1 
				AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			)b
			ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
			WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
		)n
		ON a.userid = n.user_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(s.end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(s.end_class_dt, 14))
		GROUP BY  CASE WHEN refund_dt <= date_sub(a.start_class_dt,8) THEN 'W-1之前'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,7) THEN 'W0D1'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W0D2'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W0D3'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W0D4'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W0D5'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W0D6'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W0D7'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_sub(a.start_class_dt,0) THEN 'W1D1'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,1) THEN 'W1D2'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,2) THEN 'W1D3'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,3) THEN 'W1D4'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,4) THEN 'W1D5'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,5) THEN 'W1D6'
		             WHEN refund_dt = date_add(a.start_class_dt,6) THEN 'W1D7'
		             WHEN refund_dt >= date_add(a.start_class_dt,7) THEN 'W2之后' END,
		          a.start_class_dt,
		          a.userid,
		          a.orderid,
		          a.ldap,
		          stage_name
	) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  order_id,
		        third_channel
		FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_try_double_ds_third_channel
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	)b
	ON a.order_id = b.order_id
)
SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
        a.stage_name,
        a.third_channel,
        a.user_type,
        int(b.user_ldap) AS user_ldap,
        int(c.user_ldap) AS user_ldap_real,
        user_cnt,
        is_canke,
        is_canke_valid,
        is_canke_duration,
        canke_duration,
        valid_watch_time,
        is_send_1v1,
        is_enter_1v1,
        1v1_renewal,
        is_renewal,
        is_attend_first_day,
        is_finish_end_class,
        fin_renewal
FROM
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        stage_name,
	        third_channel,
	        user_type,
	        COUNT(distinct a.userid) AS user_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_canke = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_canke,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_canke_valid = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_canke_valid,
	        COUNT(distinct if(canke_duration > 0,a.userid,null)) AS is_canke_duration,
	        SUM(canke_duration) AS canke_duration,
	        SUM(valid_watch_time) AS valid_watch_time,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_send_1v1 = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_send_1v1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_enter_1v1 = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_enter_1v1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1 AND is_enter_1v1 = 1,a.userid,null)) AS 1v1_renewal,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_renewal,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_attend_first_day = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_attend_first_day,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_finish_end_class = 1,a.userid,null)) AS is_finish_end_class,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1 AND is_finish_end_class = 1,a.userid,null)) AS fin_renewal
	FROM detail a
	GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
	          stage_name,
	          third_channel,
	          user_type
) a
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        stage_name,
	        COUNT(distinct userid)/COUNT(distinct ldap) AS user_ldap
	FROM detail
	GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
	          stage_name
)b
ON a.start_class_dt = b.start_class_dt AND a.stage_name = b.stage_name
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        stage_name,
	        COUNT(distinct userid)/COUNT(distinct ldap) AS user_ldap
	FROM detail
	WHERE user_type = '未退费'
	GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
	          stage_name
)c
ON a.start_class_dt = c.start_class_dt AND a.stage_name = c.stage_name

mario_template_name: 阶段测指标（运营汇报用）
file_content:
SELECT
    a.week_dt                                                           AS `在课周周一`,
    a.subject,
    a.start_dt                                                          AS `开课周`,
    a.period_type,
    a.stage_name,
    a.teacher_city,
    a.stage_weekidx                                                     AS `在课周进度`,
    -- 已结束进度：本期最近一个已完全结束的在课周对应的 stage_week_idx，用 UxWx 表示
    -- W 写完整 idx（如 W5→U2W5、W13→U4W13），不取余数
    CONCAT(
        'U', CEIL(MAX(m.cur_progress) / 4.0),
        'W', MAX(m.cur_progress)
    )                                                                   AS `已结束进度`,

    -- ========= 阶段测指标（原有） =========
    -- 口径：dt=yesterday 最新累计快照 + 补考日期限制在阶段测当周周日（= week_dt + 6 天）之前
    --       与原模板 dt = week_dt + 6 的历史快照口径对齐
    count(DISTINCT b.userid)                                                           AS `应参考人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(
        is_finish_official_exam = '1'
        OR (is_finish_makeup_exam = '1' AND makeup_exam_finish_dt <= date_add(a.week_dt, 6)),
        b.userid, NULL))                                                               AS `参考人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(is_finish_official_exam = '1', b.userid, NULL))                  AS `参与正式考的人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(
        is_finish_makeup_exam = '1' AND makeup_exam_finish_dt <= date_add(a.week_dt, 6),
        b.userid, NULL))                                                               AS `补考人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(exam_level = 1, b.userid, NULL))                                 AS `阶段测S人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(exam_level = 2, b.userid, NULL))                                 AS `阶段测A+人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(exam_level = 3, b.userid, NULL))                                 AS `阶段测A人数`,
    count(DISTINCT IF(exam_level = 4, b.userid, NULL))                                 AS `阶段测B人数`,

    -- ========= 阶段总结沟通（新增） =========
    -- 整体覆盖（W48 置 NULL）
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT c.userid))                                        AS `阶段总结沟通覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.has_success = 1, c.userid, NULL)))           AS `阶段总结成功沟通覆盖人数`,
    -- 人均电话时长（秒） = sum(duration) / 窗口内有过电话时长的去重用户数
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48, NULL,
       sum(c.total_duration)
         / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT IF(c.total_duration > 0, c.userid, NULL)), 0)) AS `人均阶段总结电话时长(秒)`,

    -- ========= 各进度沟通累计覆盖人数（新增） =========
    -- 累计口径：截止 W+N，interview_week ≤ stage_weekidx+N 的用户去重计数
    -- 展示条件：最近已完全结束的在课周 idx 与阶段测周 idx 的差 >= N
    --   即 MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx >= N
    -- W48 行无对应沟通窗口，始终置 NULL
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 1, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 1, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+1阶段总结沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 2, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 2, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+2阶段总结沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 3, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 3, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+3阶段总结沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 4, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 4, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+4阶段总结沟通累计覆盖人数`,

    -- ========= 各进度成功沟通累计覆盖人数（新增） =========
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 1, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 1 AND c.has_success = 1, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+1阶段总结成功沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 2, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 2 AND c.has_success = 1, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+2阶段总结成功沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 3, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 3 AND c.has_success = 1, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+3阶段总结成功沟通累计覆盖人数`,
    IF(a.stage_weekidx = 48 OR MAX(m.cur_progress) - a.stage_weekidx < 4, NULL,
       count(DISTINCT IF(c.interview_week <= a.stage_weekidx + 4 AND c.has_success = 1, c.userid, NULL))) AS `截止W+4阶段总结成功沟通累计覆盖人数`

FROM
(
    SELECT
        subject_id                                          AS subject,
        period_type,
        regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-')[1], '/', '-') AS start_dt,
        season_type,
        stage_name,
        week_dt,
        CAST(stage_week_idx AS INT)                         AS stage_weekidx,
        CEIL(stage_week_idx / 12)                           AS stage_jieduan,
        user_id                                             AS userid,
        teacher_city,
        teacher_ldap,
        team_leader_ldap,
        district_leader_ldap,
        is_first_purchase_user
    FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
    WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
      AND subject_id IN ('1', '2', '3')
      AND week_dt < date_sub(next_day(CURRENT_DATE, 'MO'), 7)
      AND {{week_dt}}
      AND {{subject_id as subject}}
      AND {{cast(stage_week_idx as int) as stage_weekidx}}
) a
LEFT JOIN
(
    -- dt 改为昨天最新累计快照；通过 show_dt 锁定到在课周
    -- 新增字段 makeup_exam_finish_dt，用于在外层按日期窗口限制补考
    SELECT
        subject_id                                          AS subject,
        stage_name,
        user_id                                             AS userid,
        is_finish_official_exam,
        is_finish_makeup_exam,
        makeup_exam_finish_dt,
        month_num,
        CAST(week_num AS INT)                               AS week_num,
        COALESCE(official_exam_level, makeup_exam_level)    AS exam_level
    FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_course_user_periodical_exam_da
    WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
      AND (stage_name = 'S6'
           OR (subject_id = '2' AND stage_name = 'S5')
           OR exam_source_type = '2')
      AND month_num IS NOT NULL
      AND {{date_sub(next_day(show_dt, 'MO'), 7) as week_dt}}
) b
  ON a.subject        = b.subject
 AND a.stage_weekidx  = b.week_num
 AND a.userid         = b.userid
 AND a.stage_name     = b.stage_name

-- ============ 新增：阶段总结沟通（communication_reasons = '21'） ============
-- 预聚合粒度 = userid + subject + stage_name + interview_week（关联键）
-- communication_status 不作为聚合键，而是通过 MAX(IF(...)) 聚成 has_success 标记，
-- 确保同一 (uid, subject, stage, week) 只有 1 行，避免与 b 表 JOIN 后 SUM 被放大。
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        userid,
        subject,
        stage_name,
        interview_week,
        SUM(duration)                                  AS total_duration,
        MAX(IF(communication_status = '2', 1, 0))      AS has_success
    FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_user_mentor_interview_season_da
    WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
      AND communication_reasons = '21'       -- 阶段总结沟通
      AND subject IN ('1', '2', '3')
    GROUP BY userid, subject, stage_name, interview_week
) c
  ON c.userid         = a.userid
 AND c.subject        = a.subject
 AND c.stage_name     = a.stage_name
 AND c.interview_week BETWEEN a.stage_weekidx + 1 AND a.stage_weekidx + 4
 AND a.stage_weekidx IN (12, 24, 36)          -- W48 不关联沟通

-- ============ 新增：cohort 已结束进度（用于 W+N 展示判定 & 已结束进度列） ============
-- 粒度：subject_id + period_type + stage_name（一期一个值）
-- 取值：本期内 week_dt < 本周周一（即该在课周已完全结束）的最大 week_dt 对应的 stage_week_idx
--       即「最近一个已完全结束的在课周」的进度
--   date_sub(next_day(CURRENT_DATE, 'MO'), 7) = 本周周一
--   week_dt 永远是周一，week_dt < 本周一 ⇔ 该周周日 ≤ 上周日 ⇔ 该周已完全结束
-- 用法：W+N 展示判定 = (cur_progress - a.stage_weekidx >= N)
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        subject_id,
        period_type,
        stage_name,
        MAX_BY(CAST(stage_week_idx AS INT), week_dt) AS cur_progress
    FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
    WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
      AND subject_id IN ('1', '2', '3')
      AND week_dt < date_sub(next_day(CURRENT_DATE, 'MO'), 7)
    GROUP BY subject_id, period_type, stage_name
) m
  ON m.subject_id  = a.subject
 AND m.period_type = a.period_type
 AND m.stage_name  = a.stage_name

GROUP BY
    a.week_dt,
    a.subject,
    a.start_dt,
    a.period_type,
    a.stage_name,
    a.teacher_city,
    a.stage_weekidx

--体验课用户转化后主动咨询体验课老师的情况 
--业务模式 
-- 期数 
-- ldap 
-- uid 
-- 沟通次数
WITH user_info AS
(
	SELECT  CASE WHEN is_bundled = '联带' THEN '英思联带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 800 THEN '英语中价'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND start_class_dt BETWEEN '2025-08-04' AND '2025-09-15' AND subject_id = 1 AND experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' THEN '英语中价'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 126 THEN '英语单带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' END AS class_mode,
	        start_class_dt,
	        user_id,
	        parent_semester_id,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        jx_end_dt,
	        MAX(renewal_order_pay_dt) AS renewal_dt
	FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND semester_label != '虚拟'
	AND {{start_class_dt}}
	AND is_renewal = 1
	GROUP BY  CASE WHEN is_bundled = '联带' THEN '英思联带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 800 THEN '英语中价'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND start_class_dt BETWEEN '2025-08-04' AND '2025-09-15' AND subject_id = 1 AND experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' THEN '英语中价'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 126 THEN '英语单带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带'
	             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' END,
	          start_class_dt,
	          user_id,
	          parent_semester_id,
	          teacher_ldap,
	          jx_end_dt
	UNION ALL
	SELECT  CASE WHEN subject_id = 4 THEN '美术'
	             WHEN subject_id = 5 THEN '写字'
	             WHEN subject_id = 7 THEN '音乐'
	             WHEN subject_id = 8 THEN '科学' END AS class_mode,
	        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
	        user_id,
	        parent_semester_id,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        jx_end_dt,
	        MAX(renewal_order_pay_dt) AS renewal_dt
	FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-')[1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}}
	GROUP BY  CASE WHEN subject_id = 4 THEN '美术'
	             WHEN subject_id = 5 THEN '写字'
	             WHEN subject_id = 7 THEN '音乐'
	             WHEN subject_id = 8 THEN '科学' END,
	          regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-'),
	          user_id,
	          parent_semester_id,
	          teacher_ldap,
	          jx_end_dt
), tab_emon_teacher_user_info AS
(
	SELECT  *
	FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_emon_wechat_user_teacher_info_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
), tab_emon_chat AS
(
	SELECT  rowkey,
	        contentType,
	        convtype,
	        chat_type,
	        CASE WHEN convtype = 0 THEN '企微-私聊'
	             WHEN convtype = 1 THEN '企微-群聊' END AS chat_type_desc,
	        DEFAULT.time2dt(createtime) AS create_dt,
	        receiver,
	        sender,
	        uploader
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  rowkey,
		        contentType,
		        convtype,
		        CASE WHEN convtype = 0 THEN 1
		             WHEN convtype = 1 THEN 2 END AS chat_type,
		        createtime,
		        receiver,
		        sender,
		        uploader
		FROM dw_ods.ods_dora_emon_chat_msg_da t1
		WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND messagestatus = 1
		AND convtype IN (0, 1)
		AND t1.sender != t1.receiver
		AND from_unixtime(CAST(createtime AS bigint), 'yyyy-MM-dd') >= '2024-12-13'
		AND contentType != '"SYSTEM"'
		AND (contentType != '"TEXT"' OR get_json_object(replace(replace(replace(content, '"{', '{'), '}"', '}'), '\\"', '"'), '$.content') NOT LIKE '我通过了你的%')
		AND (contentType != '"TEXT"' OR get_json_object(replace(replace(replace(content, '"{', '{'), '}"', '}'), '\\"', '"'), '$.content') NOT LIKE '我是%') 
	) tt
)
SELECT  class_mode,
        start_class_dt,
        a.teacher_ldap as ldap,
        a.user_id as userid,
        a.renewal_dt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT if(sender_type = 'user' AND chat_type_desc = '企微-私聊',rowkey,NULL)) AS si_user_send_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT if(sender_type = 'user' AND chat_type_desc = '企微-群聊',rowkey,NULL)) AS qun_user_send_cnt
FROM user_info a
JOIN
(
	SELECT  tab_emon_chat.rowkey,
	        tab_emon_chat.chat_type_desc,
	        tab_emon_chat.contentType,
	        CASE WHEN tab_emon_chat.uploader = tab_emon_chat.sender THEN 'teacher'  ELSE 'user' END AS sender_type,
	        tab_from_info.user_id AS sender_userid,
	        CASE WHEN tab_emon_chat.chat_type = 2 THEN 'chat_room'  ELSE tab_to_info.user_id END AS receiver_userid,
	        tab_uploader_info.user_id AS uploader_userid,
	        create_dt
	FROM tab_emon_chat
	JOIN tab_emon_teacher_user_info tab_from_info
	ON tab_emon_chat.sender = tab_from_info.remoteid  AND tab_from_info.user_type = 'user' 
	LEFT JOIN tab_emon_teacher_user_info tab_to_info
	ON tab_emon_chat.receiver = tab_to_info.remoteid AND tab_emon_chat.chat_type_desc = '企微-私聊' AND tab_to_info.user_type = 'teacher'
	JOIN tab_emon_teacher_user_info tab_uploader_info
	ON tab_emon_chat.uploader = tab_uploader_info.remoteid AND tab_uploader_info.user_type = 'teacher'
)c
ON (c.create_dt BETWEEN date_add(renewal_dt, 1) AND jx_end_dt) AND a.teacher_ldap = c.uploader_userid AND ((c.sender_userid = a.user_id AND c.receiver_userid = a.teacher_ldap AND c.chat_type_desc = '企微-私聊') OR (c.sender_userid = a.user_id AND c.chat_type_desc = '企微-群聊'))
GROUP BY  class_mode,
          start_class_dt,
          a.teacher_ldap,
          a.user_id,
           a.renewal_dt

-- set hive.new.job.grouping.set.cardinality = 256;


select 
  -- coalesce(a.dt,'total_count') as dt 
  coalesce(pagepattern,'total_count')as pagepattern
  ,coalesce(coalesce(ped_status,'新用户'),'total_count') as ped_status
  ,coalesce(a.appid,'total_count') as appid 
  ,coalesce(keyfrom,'total_count') as keyfrom
  ,coalesce(memberbutton,'total_count')as memberbutton
  ,count(distinct if(action='expose',userid,null))as exp_unt
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,userid,null))as click_unt

  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,b.user_id,null)) as clickandold_uv
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,b.user_id,null))
    /count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,userid,null)) as old_rate
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1 
    and b.user_id is null ,d.user_id,null)) as clickandsmall_uv
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1 
    and b.user_id is null ,d.user_id,null))
      /count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,userid,null))as small_rate
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1 
    and b.user_id is null and d.user_id is null ,userid,null)) as clicknew_uv
  ,count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1 
    and b.user_id is null and d.user_id is null ,userid,null))
      /count(distinct if(action='click' and userstatus=1,userid,null)) as new_rate

from 
(
  select
    dt,
    appid,
    userid,
    url,
    keyfrom,
      userstatus,
      memberbutton, -- 是否vip
      if(url='/click/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton','click','expose')as action,
      if(pagepattern ='1','融合售卖页','h5售卖页')as pagepattern
  from 
  (
      select dt,
        '斑马app' as appid,
        user_id as userid,
        url,
          CASE 
          WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
          when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
              when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
            when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
              when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
              WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
              when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
          ELSE keyfrom
        END AS keyfrom,
        other['skuid'] as skuid,
        coalesce(other['userstatus'],other['islogin']) as userstatus,
        case when other['memberbutton'] in (2,3) then 'vip'
          when other['memberbutton'] in (0,1) then 'unvip'
          else 'unset' end as memberbutton,
        other['issalecombine']as pagepattern, other['packid'] AS packid
      from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_frog_di
      where dt between'{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
      and url in('/event/CommerceIntroWechat/enter',
        '/event/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton',
        '/click/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton')
      -- and class_name in('event','click')
      -- and method_name in('CommerceIntroWechat')
          and category in ('click','event')
          and page_tp in ('C')
          and ((url='/event/CommerceIntroWechat/enter' and other['buymode']=3)
          or url in ('/click/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton',
            '/event/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton'))

       union all 

        select 
          dt,
          '百科app' as appid,
          userid,
          url,
            CASE 
            WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
            when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
                when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
              when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
                when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
                WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
                when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
            ELSE keyfrom
          END AS keyfrom,
          other['skuid'] as skuid,
          coalesce(other['userstatus'],other['islogin']) as userstatus,
          case when other['memberbutton'] in (2,3) then 'vip'
            when other['memberbutton'] in (0,1) then 'unvip'
            else 'unset' end as memberbutton,
          other['issalecombine']as pagepattern, other['packid'] AS packid
        from dw_ods.ods_pedia_frog
        where dt between'{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
        and url in('/event/CommerceIntroWechat/enter',
          '/event/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton',
          '/click/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton')
            and category in ('click','event')
            and page_tp in ('C')
            and ((url='/event/CommerceIntroWechat/enter' and other['buymode']=3)
            or url in ('/click/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton',
              '/event/CommerceIntroWechat/reservationButton'))  
  )a1
    left JOIN (
      SELECT sku_id AS skuid, package_id AS packageid
      FROM dw_dim.dim_conan_sku_package_rela_da a
      WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
        AND package_id ='{{{value}}}'
    ) a2 ON a1.skuid = a2.skuid
  where a2.packageid is not null or a1.packid='{{{value}}}'
  
  union all
  select 
    dt,
    appid,
    userid,
    url,
    keyfrom,
    userstatus,
    'unset'as memberbutton,
    if(url='/click/activity/reservation','click','expose')as action,
    '纯图预约页'as pagepattern
  from 
  (
    select dt,'斑马app' as appid
      ,user_id as userid,url,
        CASE 
        WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
        when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
            when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
          when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
            when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
            WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
            when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
        ELSE keyfrom
      END AS keyfrom
        ,other['userstatus'] as userstatus,other['clicktype'] as clicktype
    from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_frog_di 
    where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
      and url in('/event/activity/reservation','/click/activity/reservation')
      and category in('event','click')
      and page_code in('activity')
        and page_tp in ('A')
      and {{ other['activityid'] }}
      and(other['clicktype']='book_now'or url='/event/activity/reservation')

    union all 

    select dt,'百科app' as appid
        ,userid,url,
        CASE 
        WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
        when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
            when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
          when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
            when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
            WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
            when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
        ELSE keyfrom
      END AS keyfrom
        ,other['userstatus'] as userstatus,other['clicktype'] as clicktype
    from dw_ods.ods_pedia_frog
    where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
      and url in('/event/activity/reservation','/click/activity/reservation')
        and category in('event','click')
        and page_tp in ('A')
      and {{ other['activityid'] }}
      and(other['clicktype']='book_now'or url='/event/activity/reservation')
  )a3
  
  union all 
    select 
        dt,
        appid,
        userid,
        url,
        coalesce(keyfrom,'newtab-h5page') keyfrom,
        userstatus,
        memberbutton,
        if(url='/click/LaunchNew/packageUpdate/reserve','click','expose')as action,
        '上新tab预约' as pagepattern
    from 
    (
        select 
            dt,
            '百科app' as appid,
            userid,
            url,
            CASE 
                WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
                when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
            when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
          when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
            when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
            WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
            when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
                ELSE keyfrom
            END AS keyfrom,
            other['packageid'] as packageid,
            coalesce(other['islogin'],'unset') as userstatus,
            if(other['isvip']=1,'vip','unvip') as memberbutton
        from dw_ods.ods_pedia_frog
        where dt between'{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
            and url in('/expose/LaunchNew/packageUpdate',
                '/click/LaunchNew/packageUpdate/reserve')
            -- and class_name in('event','click')
            -- and method_name in('CommerceIntroWechat')
            and category in ('click','expose')
            and page_tp in ('L')
            and ((url='/expose/LaunchNew/packageUpdate' and other['type']in (2,3))
            or url ='/click/LaunchNew/packageUpdate/reserve')
            and (other['packageid'] ='{{{value}}}' or other['packagename'] ='{{{packname}}}')
      
        union all 
        select 
            dt,
            '斑马app' as appid,
            user_id,
            url,
            CASE 
                WHEN keyfrom IS NULL THEN 'unset'
                when keyfrom like '%teacher%' then 'teacher'
            when keyfrom like 'app-expand%' then 'app-expand'
          when keyfrom like 'app-extend%' then 'app-expand'
            when keyfrom like '%zebravideo%' then 'zebravideo'
            WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%siyu%' THEN 'siyu'
            when keyfrom like '%bkapp-level_list%' then 'bkapp-level_list'
                ELSE keyfrom
            END AS keyfrom,
            other['packageid'] as packageid,
            coalesce(other['islogin'],'unset') as userstatus,
            if(other['isvip']=1,'vip','unvip') as memberbutton
        from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_frog_di 
        where dt between'{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
            and url in('/expose/LaunchNew/packageUpdate',
                '/click/LaunchNew/packageUpdate/reserve')
            -- and class_name in('event','click')
            -- and method_name in('CommerceIntroWechat')
            and category in ('click','expose')
            and page_tp in ('L')
            and ((url='/expose/LaunchNew/packageUpdate' and other['type']in (2,3))
            or url ='/click/LaunchNew/packageUpdate/reserve')
            and (other['packageid'] ='{{{value}}}' or other['packagename'] ='{{{packname}}}')
    )a4 
)a 
left join 
(
  select dt,user_id
  from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_pedia_da
  where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
    and pay_dt>='2022-06-21'
    and order_status_cd=2
    and is_test_user=0
    and keyfrom not like '%test%'
  group by dt,user_id

  union all
  select 
    dt,
    user_id
  from dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_pedia_vip_order_da
  where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
    and order_status_cd=2
    and is_test_user=0
    and sku_name not like '%内测%'
    and vip_type_name= '百科正式会员'
  group by dt,user_id
) b 
on a.dt=b.dt and a.userid=b.user_id
left join 
(-- 小课包 & 体验会员
  select  dt,user_id
  from dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_pedia_smallpack_da
  where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
    and pay_dt>='2022-06-21'
    and order_status_cd=2
    and is_test_user=0
    and keyfrom not like '%test%'
    AND packageid != ''
  group by dt,user_id

  union all
  select dt,user_id
  from dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_pedia_vip_order_da
  where dt between '{{{startdt}}}' and '{{{enddt}}}'
  and is_test_user=0
  and vip_type_name='百科体验会员'
  group by dt,user_id
) d  
on a.dt=d.dt and a.userid=d.user_id
left join
( select user_id,ped_status,dt
  from dw_conan_dim.dim_conan_user_pedia_user_da
  where dt between date_sub('{{{startdt}}}',1) and '{{{enddt}}}'
  group by user_id,ped_status,dt
) as c on date_add(a.dt,1)=c.dt and a.userid=c.user_id
group by pagepattern,appid,keyfrom,memberbutton,coalesce(ped_status,'新用户') with cube
