file_content:
--老师退费情况 
-- 期次、级别、老师ldap、组长ldap、主管ldap、城市 
-- 总退费率（截止W3）、W0退费率、W1退费率、W2退费率 
-- 截止W3D7转化率、总成单数、W0先报后退单数、W1先报后退单数、W2先报后退单数、W3先报后退单数、该级别达成率全国排名
SELECT  start_class_dt AS `期次`,
        stage_name AS `级别`,
        teacher_ldap AS `老师ldap`,
        team_leader_ldap AS `组长ldap`,
        district_leader_ldap AS `主管ldap`,
        teacher_city AS `城市`,
        refun_rate AS `总退费率（截止W3）`,
        refund_user_rate_w0 AS `W0退费率`,
        refund_user_rate_w1 AS `W1退费率`,
        refund_user_rate_w2 AS `W2退费率`,
        renew_rate AS `截止W3D7转化率`,
        renew_cnt_w0 AS `W0先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w1 AS `W1先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w2 AS `W2先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w3 AS `W3先报后退单数`,
        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY start_class_dt,stage_name ORDER BY  targrt_renew_rate DESC) AS `该级别达成率全国排名`
FROM
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        stage_name,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        team_leader_ldap,
	        district_leader_ldap,
	        teacher_city,
	        COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS user_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refun_rate,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= start_class_dt AND refund_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= start_class_dt AND refund_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND refund_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND refund_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null)) AS should_renew_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null)) AS renew_rate,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt >= start_class_dt AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt > a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w3,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null))/MAX(targetrate) AS targrt_renew_rate
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.type,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        a.end_class_dt,
		        a.stage_name,
		        a.teacher_ldap,
		        b.team_leader_ldap,
		        b.district_leader_ldap,
		        b.teacher_city,
		        a.user_id,
		        a.semester_id,
		        a.is_renewal,
		        a.renewal_order_pay_dt,
		        a.is_refund,
		        a.refund_dt
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  '在课' AS type,
			        start_class_dt,
			        end_class_dt,
			        stage_name,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        team_leader_ldap,
			        district_leader_ldap,
			        teacher_city,
			        user_id,
			        semester_id,
			        is_renewal,
			        renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        0 AS is_refund,
			        0 AS refund_dt
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (1)
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND ((experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' AND start_class_dt < '2025-09-22') or lesson_id = 800)
			AND user_from = '电商探索'
			AND semester_label != '虚拟' 
			UNION ALL
			SELECT  '退款' AS type,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        a.end_class_dt,
			        start_stage_name AS stage_name,
			        a.teacher_ldap,
			        a.team_leader_ldap,
			        a.district_leader_ldap,
			        a.teacher_city,
			        CAST(a.userid AS STRING) AS user_id,
			        CAST(semesterid AS STRING) AS semester_id,
			        MAX(if(n.order_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_renewal,
			        MAX(pay_dt) AS renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        MAX(if(a.refund_dt is not null,1,0)) AS is_refund,
			        MAX(refund_dt) AS refund_dt
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        orderid,
				        start_class_dt,
				        refund_dt,
				        refund_tp,
				        end_class_dt,
				        start_stage_name,
				        teacher_ldap,
				        team_leader_ldap,
				        district_leader_ldap,
				        teacher_city
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  a.userid,
					        a.semesterid,
					        a.classid,
					        a.teacherid,
					        a.orderid,
					        a.start_class_dt,
					        refund_dt,
					        refund_tp,
					        end_class_dt,
					        start_stage_name,
					        coalesce(c.teacher_ldap,a.ldap) AS teacher_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.team_leader_ldap,a.team_leader_ldap) AS team_leader_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.district_leader_ldap,a.district_leader_ldap) AS district_leader_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.teacher_city,a.mentor_org_city) AS teacher_city,
					        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.userid,a.start_class_dt ORDER BY  coalesce(refund_tp,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
					FROM
					( -- 订单 表
						SELECT  b.*,
						        orderid,
						        ldap,
						        team_leader_ldap,
						        district_leader_ldap,
						        mentor_org_city
						FROM
						(
							SELECT  orderid,
							        userid,
							        id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
							WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
						) a
						JOIN
						( -- 分班 表
							SELECT  userid,
							        semesterid,
							        classid,
							        teacherid,
							        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
							        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND lessonid IN ('126', '800')
							AND type = 1
							AND status <> 3
							AND {{from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt}} 
						) b
						ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
						LEFT JOIN
						(
							SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
							        team_leader_ldap,
							        district_leader_ldap,
							        mentor_org_city,
							        tf.key AS teacherid
							FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
							WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
						)c
						ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
					) a
					JOIN
					(
						SELECT  semester_id,
						        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
						        end_class_dt,
						        parent_semester_id,
						        start_stage_name
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
						AND ((experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' AND start_class_dt < '2025-09-22') or lesson_id = 800)
						AND subject_id = 1
						AND is_bundled = 0 
					)s
					ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  class_id,
						        teacher_city,
						        teacher_ldap,
						        team_leader_ldap,
						        district_leader_ldap
						FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
						WHERE dt = end_class_dt
						AND {{start_class_dt}}
						AND subject_id IN (1)
						AND is_bundled = '单带'
						AND ((experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' AND start_class_dt < '2025-09-22') or lesson_id = 800)
						AND semester_label != '虚拟'
						GROUP BY  class_id,
						          teacher_city,
						          teacher_ldap,
						          team_leader_ldap,
						          district_leader_ldap
					)c
					ON a.classid = c.class_id
					LEFT JOIN
					( -- 退款 表
						SELECT  order_id,
						        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
						        refund_tp,
						        refundment_type_name,
						        refundment_reason
						FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND refund_status_code = 2
						AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
					) b
					ON a.orderid = b.order_id
				)a
				WHERE rk = 1
				and  refund_dt is not null 
			)a
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        classid,
				        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				GROUP BY  userid,
				          classid
			)t
			ON a.userid = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        order_id,
				        pay_dt,
				        subject_id,
				        pay_tp,
				        first_refund_tp,
				        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
				        refund_related_weekcount
				FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
				WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
				AND semester_type IN ('season')
				AND order_status >= 2
				AND subject_id = 1 
			)n
			ON a.userid = n.user_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(end_class_dt, 14))
			GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
			          a.end_class_dt,
			          start_stage_name,
			          a.teacher_ldap,
			          a.team_leader_ldap,
			          a.district_leader_ldap,
			          a.teacher_city,
			          CAST(a.userid AS STRING),
			          CAST(semesterid AS STRING)
		)a
		JOIN
		(
			SELECT  start_class_dt,
			        semester_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        team_leader_ldap,
			        district_leader_ldap,
			        teacher_city
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (1)
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND ((experiment_tag LIKE '%C%' AND start_class_dt < '2025-09-22') or lesson_id = 800)
			AND user_from = '电商探索'
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
			          semester_id,
			          teacher_ldap,
			          team_leader_ldap,
			          district_leader_ldap,
			          teacher_city
		) b
		ON a.teacher_ldap = b.teacher_ldap AND a.semester_id = b.semester_id
	)a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  dim_main_semester_id as dimmainsemesterid,
		        if(backtrace_target_rate is not null AND backtrace_target_rate > 0,backtrace_target_rate,target_rate) AS targetrate
		FROM dw_conan_ods.ods_conan_exp_stat_double_experience_transform_org_stat_v3_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND entity_type = 0
		AND entity_id = 2
		AND layer = ''
		AND dim_subjects IN (1) 
	)b
	ON a.semester_id = b.dimmainsemesterid
	GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
	          stage_name,
	          teacher_ldap,
	          team_leader_ldap,
	          district_leader_ldap,
	          teacher_city
)a

select

    ,coalesce(user_funnel.pageid, 'total_count') as pageid
    ,coalesce(nvl(keyfrom, '空'), 'total_count') as keyfrom_type
    ,coalesce(nvl(user_type,'新用户'), 'total_count') as user_type
    ,count(distinct if(user_funnel.url = '/event/ClassIntroWechat/enter', user_funnel.userid,null)) as salepage_show_uv
    ,count(distinct if(user_funnel.url = '/click/ClassIntroWechat/purchaseButton', user_funnel.userid,null)) as salepage_clickbuy_uv
    ,count(distinct if(user_funnel.url = '/event/OrderConfirmation/enter', user_funnel.userid,null)) as salepage_confirm_uv
    ,count(distinct if(user_funnel.url = '/click/OrderConfirmation/payButton', user_funnel.userid,null)) as salepage_clickpay_uv
    ,count(distinct paid_info.userid) as order_uv
    ,count(distinct paid_info.orderid) as order_cnt
from
    (-- 售卖页曝光 url = '/event/ClassIntroWechat/enter'
        select
            user_id as userid
            ,dt
            ,other['pageid'] as pageid 
            ,other['orderid'] as orderid
            ,url
            ,keyfrom
        from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_frog_di
        where dt between '{{{startTime}}}' and '{{{endTime}}}'
            and default.time2dt(action_tp) = dt
            and url in
            (
                '/event/ClassIntroWechat/enter' -- 售卖页曝光
                ,'/click/ClassIntroWechat/purchaseButton' -- 点击立即购买
                ,'/event/OrderConfirmation/enter' -- 订单页曝光
                ,'/click/OrderConfirmation/payButton' -- 点击立即支付
                ,'/event/OrderConfirmation/status' -- 订单确认页曝光,里面有orderid
            )
            and category in('event','click')
            and page_tp in ('C','O') -- url二级的首字母
            and {{other['pageid']}}
        group by
            user_id
            ,dt
            ,other['pageid']
            ,other['orderid']
            ,url
            ,keyfrom
    ) user_funnel
left join
    (-- 支付成功的用户 用orderid关联订单表
     --购课信息：最早的0元课+1元课+体验课+系统课订单信息，包含退款
		select user_id as userid
              ,order_id as orderid
              ,parent_order_id
           	  ,pay_dt
    	from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
    	where dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
        and pay_dt between '{{{startTime}}}' and '{{{endTime}}}'
    	and order_status >= '2'
    	and (semester_type in ('try', 'try_paid', 'try_refer', 'try_refer_triple', 'try_double', 'season')
    	or semester_type like 'try_refer%')
    	group by user_id
                ,order_id
                ,pay_dt
                ,parent_order_id
    ) paid_info
on user_funnel.userid = paid_info.userid
and user_funnel.dt = paid_info.pay_dt
and( user_funnel.orderid = paid_info.orderid
     or user_funnel.orderid = paid_info.parent_order_id
    )
left join 
(
    select userid
           ,user_type
           ,dt
    from dw_dwd.dwd_market_user_info_da_no_sensitive_view 
  -- dw_dwd.dwd_market_user_info_da
    where dt >= date_sub('{{{startTime}}}', 1)
) user_type
on user_funnel.userid = user_type.userid 
and user_funnel.dt = date_add(user_type.dt,1) -- 取进入售卖页前一天的用户身份
group by
    user_funnel.dt
    ,user_funnel.pageid
    ,nvl(keyfrom, '空')
    ,nvl(user_type,'新用户')

file_content:
--开课周周一
--结课周周一
--当前进度
--classid
--学科、级别
--当前老师/组长/主管/城市/身份
--班级被甩次数
--最近一次被甩的进度

select
    start_class_dt as `开课日期`
    ,end_class_dt as `结课日期`
    ,'{{{current_week_dt}}}' as `观测周一日期`
    ,stage_weekidx as `观测周一进度W`
    ,case subject when '1' then '英语' when '2' then '思维' when '3' then '阅读' end as `学科`
    ,stage_name as `级别`
    ,a.classid as `classid`
    ,teacher_ldap as `老师ldap`
    ,teacher_leader_ldap as `组长ldap`
    ,district_leader_ldap as `主管ldap`
    ,teacher_city as `老师城市`
    ,teacher_role as `老师状态`
    ,coalesce(shuai_times,0) as `截止观测周班级被甩次数`
    ,coalesce(shuai_max_idx,-1) as `截止观测周班级最后被甩进度W`
from
(
    select
        start_class_dt
        ,date_sub(next_day(end_class_dt,'MO'),7) as end_class_dt
        ,stage_week_idx as stage_weekidx
        ,subject_id as subject
        ,stage_name
        ,class_id as classid
        ,teacher_ldap
        ,count(distinct user_id) as user_num
    from dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
    where dt=date_sub(current_date,1)
        and subject_id in ('1','2','3')
        and week_dt='{{{current_week_dt}}}'
        and {{start_class_dt}}
        and {{date_sub(next_day(end_class_dt,'MO'),7) as end_class_dt}}
    group by start_class_dt
        ,end_class_dt
        ,stage_week_idx
        ,subject_id
        ,stage_name
        ,class_id
        ,teacher_ldap
) a

left join
(
    select
        classid
        ,count(distinct shuai_dt) as shuai_times
        ,max(shuai_weekidx) as shuai_max_idx
    from
    (
        select 
            classid
            ,date_sub(next_day(from_unixtime(int(throwclassstarttime/1000)),'MO'),7) as shuai_dt
            ,min(weeknum) as shuai_weekidx
        from dw_ori.ori_mysql_conan_mentor_class_schedule_teacher_da
        where deleted='0'
            and throwclass='1'
            and substr(stageid, 1, 1) in ('1','2','3')
            and throwclassstarttime > 0
            and default.time2dt(int(expectedtime/1000))<='{{{current_week_dt}}}'
        group by classid,date_sub(next_day(from_unixtime(int(throwclassstarttime/1000)),'MO'),7)
    ) a
    group by classid
) b on a.classid=b.classid

left join
(
    select
        mentor_ldap
        ,team_leader_ldap as teacher_leader_ldap
        ,district_leader_ldap as district_leader_ldap
        ,mentor_org_city as teacher_city
        ,case mentor_display_status
            when 'init' then '待分配'
            when 'training' then '培训中'
            when 'newMentor' then '新老师'
            when 'matureMentor' then '成熟老师'
            when 'manager' then '管理者'
            when 'longVacation' then '长假中'
            when 'toLeave' then '待流失'
            when 'toBeDeleted' then '待销户'
            when 'disabled' then '已销户'
            else '未知'
        end as teacher_role
        ,dt
    from dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da
    where dt=date_sub(current_date,1) or dt='{{{current_week_dt}}}' --取昨天或者观测周的固化数据
) tl on a.teacher_ldap=tl.mentor_ldap
    and ((a.end_class_dt!='{{{current_week_dt}}}' and tl.dt=date_sub(current_date,1)) --如果是统一开课日期，取昨天的架构
        or (a.end_class_dt='{{{current_week_dt}}}' and tl.dt='{{{current_week_dt}}}')) --如果是统一结课日期，取观测周的架构

file_content:
--思维中价老师退费情况 
-- 期次、级别、老师ldap、组长ldap、主管ldap、城市 
-- 总退费率（截止W3）、W0退费率、W1退费率、W2退费率 
-- 截止W3D7转化率、总成单数、W0先报后退单数、W1先报后退单数、W2先报后退单数、W3先报后退单数、该级别达成率全国排名
SELECT  start_class_dt AS `期次`,
        stage_name AS `级别`,
        teacher_ldap AS `老师ldap`,
        team_leader_ldap AS `组长ldap`,
        district_leader_ldap AS `主管ldap`,
        teacher_city AS `城市`,
        user_cnt AS `中价课用户数`,
        refun_rate AS `总退费率（截止W3）`,
        refund_user_rate_w0 AS `W0退费率`,
        refund_user_rate_w1 AS `W1退费率`,
        refund_user_rate_w2 AS `W2退费率`,
        renew_rate AS `截止W3D7转化率`,
        renew_cnt_w0 AS `W0先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w1 AS `W1先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w2 AS `W2先报后退单数`,
        renew_cnt_w3 AS `W3先报后退单数`,
        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY start_class_dt,stage_name ORDER BY  targrt_renew_rate DESC) AS `该级别达成率全国排名`
FROM
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        stage_name,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        team_leader_ldap,
	        district_leader_ldap,
	        teacher_city,
	        COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS user_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refun_rate,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= start_class_dt AND refund_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= start_class_dt AND refund_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND refund_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS refund_user_cnt_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_refund = 1 AND refund_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND refund_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS refund_user_rate_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null)) AS should_renew_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null)) AS renew_rate,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt < start_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w0,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt >= start_class_dt AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,7),a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w1,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt >= date_sub(a.end_class_dt,6) AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w2,
	        COUNT(distinct if(type = '退款' AND is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt > a.end_class_dt,a.user_id,null)) AS renew_cnt_w3,
	        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,a.user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct if(type = '在课' or (is_renewal = 1 AND type = '退款'),a.user_id,null))/MAX(targetrate) AS targrt_renew_rate
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.type,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        a.end_class_dt,
		        a.stage_name,
		        a.teacher_ldap,
		        b.team_leader_ldap,
		        b.district_leader_ldap,
		        b.teacher_city,
		        a.user_id,
		        a.semester_id,
		        a.is_renewal,
		        a.renewal_order_pay_dt,
		        a.is_refund,
		        a.refund_dt
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  '在课' AS type,
			        start_class_dt,
			        end_class_dt,
			        stage_name,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        team_leader_ldap,
			        district_leader_ldap,
			        teacher_city,
			        user_id,
			        semester_id,
			        is_renewal,
			        renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        0 AS is_refund,
			        0 AS refund_dt
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (2)
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价')
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			UNION ALL
			SELECT  '退款' AS type,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        a.end_class_dt,
			        start_stage_name AS stage_name,
			        a.teacher_ldap,
			        a.team_leader_ldap,
			        a.district_leader_ldap,
			        a.teacher_city,
			        CAST(a.userid AS STRING) AS user_id,
			        CAST(semesterid AS STRING) AS semester_id,
			        MAX(if(n.order_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_renewal,
			        MAX(pay_dt) AS renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        MAX(if(a.refund_dt is not null,1,0)) AS is_refund,
			        MAX(refund_dt) AS refund_dt
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        orderid,
				        start_class_dt,
				        refund_dt,
				        refund_tp,
				        end_class_dt,
				        start_stage_name,
				        teacher_ldap,
				        team_leader_ldap,
				        district_leader_ldap,
				        teacher_city
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  a.userid,
					        a.semesterid,
					        a.classid,
					        a.teacherid,
					        a.orderid,
					        a.start_class_dt,
					        refund_dt,
					        refund_tp,
					        end_class_dt,
					        start_stage_name,
					        coalesce(c.teacher_ldap,a.ldap) AS teacher_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.team_leader_ldap,a.team_leader_ldap) AS team_leader_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.district_leader_ldap,a.district_leader_ldap) AS district_leader_ldap,
					        coalesce(c.teacher_city,a.mentor_org_city) AS teacher_city,
					        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.userid,a.start_class_dt ORDER BY  coalesce(refund_tp,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
					FROM
					( -- 订单 表
						SELECT  b.*,
						        orderid,
						        ldap,
						        team_leader_ldap,
						        district_leader_ldap,
						        mentor_org_city
						FROM
						(
							SELECT  orderid,
							        userid,
							        id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
							WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
						) a
						JOIN
						( -- 分班 表
							SELECT  userid,
							        semesterid,
							        classid,
							        teacherid,
							        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
							        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
							FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND lessonid IN ('70')
							AND type = 1
							AND status <> 3
							AND {{from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt}} 
						) b
						ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
                      JOIN
						(
							SELECT  order_id
							FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_trade_try_double_order_from_info_da
							WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
							AND ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价')
						)d
						ON a.orderid = d.order_id
						LEFT JOIN
						(
							SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
							        team_leader_ldap,
							        district_leader_ldap,
							        mentor_org_city,
							        tf.key AS teacherid
							FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
							WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
						)c
						ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
					) a
					JOIN
					(
						SELECT  semester_id,
						        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
						        end_class_dt,
						        parent_semester_id,
						        start_stage_name
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
						AND subject_id = 2
						AND is_bundled = 0 
					)s
					ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  class_id,
						        teacher_city,
						        teacher_ldap,
						        team_leader_ldap,
						        district_leader_ldap
						FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
						WHERE dt = end_class_dt
						AND {{start_class_dt}}
						AND subject_id IN (2)
						AND is_bundled = '单带'
						AND ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价')
						AND semester_label != '虚拟'
						GROUP BY  class_id,
						          teacher_city,
						          teacher_ldap,
						          team_leader_ldap,
						          district_leader_ldap
					)c
					ON a.classid = c.class_id
					LEFT JOIN
					( -- 退款 表
						SELECT  order_id,
						        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
						        refund_tp,
						        refundment_type_name,
						        refundment_reason
						FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND refund_status_code = 2
						AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
					) b
					ON a.orderid = b.order_id
				)a
				WHERE rk = 1
				AND refund_dt is not null 
			)a
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        classid,
				        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				GROUP BY  userid,
				          classid
			)t
			ON a.userid = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        order_id,
				        pay_dt,
				        subject_id,
				        pay_tp,
				        first_refund_tp,
				        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
				        refund_related_weekcount
				FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
				WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
				AND semester_type IN ('season')
				AND order_status >= 2
				AND subject_id = 2 
			)n
			ON a.userid = n.user_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(end_class_dt, 14))
			GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
			          a.end_class_dt,
			          start_stage_name,
			          a.teacher_ldap,
			          a.team_leader_ldap,
			          a.district_leader_ldap,
			          a.teacher_city,
			          CAST(a.userid AS STRING),
			          CAST(semesterid AS STRING)
		)a
		JOIN
		(
			SELECT  start_class_dt,
			        semester_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        team_leader_ldap,
			        district_leader_ldap,
			        teacher_city
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (2)
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价')
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
			          semester_id,
			          teacher_ldap,
			          team_leader_ldap,
			          district_leader_ldap,
			          teacher_city
		) b
		ON a.teacher_ldap = b.teacher_ldap AND a.semester_id = b.semester_id
	)a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  dim_main_semester_id AS dimmainsemesterid,
		        if(backtrace_target_rate is not null AND backtrace_target_rate > 0,backtrace_target_rate,target_rate) AS targetrate
		FROM dw_conan_ods.ods_conan_exp_stat_double_experience_transform_org_stat_v3_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND entity_type = 0
		AND entity_id = 2
		AND layer = ''
		AND dim_subjects IN (2) 
	)b
	ON a.semester_id = b.dimmainsemesterid
	GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
	          stage_name,
	          teacher_ldap,
	          team_leader_ldap,
	          district_leader_ldap,
	          teacher_city
)a

file_content:
SELECT  userid AS `userid`,
        subject_name AS `学科`,
        start_class_dt AS `开课期次`,
        semester_type AS `体验课模式`,
        stage_name AS `体验课级别`,
        renewal_orderid as `系统课订单id`,
        season_type AS `系统课类型`,
        season_pay_dt AS `购买系统课日期`,
        pay_tp AS `购买系统课时间`,
        season_from AS `系统课订单来源`,
        keyfrom_cov AS `系统课订单keyfrom`,
        pay_amt AS `成单金额`,
        ldap AS `老师ldap`,
        leader_ldap AS `组长ldap`
FROM
(
	SELECT  userid,
	        ldap,
	        leader_ldap,
	        CASE WHEN subject = 4 THEN '美术'
	             WHEN subject = 5 THEN '写字'
	             WHEN subject = 7 THEN '音乐'
	             WHEN subject = 8 THEN '科学'
	             WHEN subject = 1 and lesson_id=800 THEN '英语中价'
	             WHEN subject = 1 THEN '英语'
	             WHEN subject = 2 and lesson_id=830 THEN '思维中价'
	             WHEN subject = 3 and lesson_id=870 THEN '阅读中价'
	             WHEN subject = 2 THEN '思维'
	             WHEN subject = 3 THEN '阅读' END AS subject_name,
	        stage_name,
	        start_class_dt,
	        CASE WHEN subject IN ('1','2','3') THEN if(is_bundled = '联带','联带','单带')  ELSE '单带' END AS semester_type,
            renewal_orderid,
	        season_type,
	        season_pay_dt,
  pay_tp,
	        season_from,
	        keyfrom_cov,
	        pay_amt 
	FROM
	( --用户基本信 息
		SELECT  user_id as userid,
		        subject_id as subject,
		        teacher_ldap as ldap,
		        team_leader_ldap as leader_ldap,
		        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
		        is_renewal,
		        renewal_order_id AS renewal_orderid,
		        semester_id as semesterid,
		        stage_name,
    '单带' as is_bundled,
     lesson_id
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{dt}}}'
		AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-')[1], '\\/', '\\-')  as start_class_dt}}
		AND {{subject_id as subject}} 
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  user_id as userid,
		        subject_id as subject,
		        teacher_ldap as ldap,
		        team_leader_ldap as leader_ldap,
		        start_class_dt,
		        is_renewal,
		        renewal_order_id as renewal_orderid,
		        parent_semester_id AS semesterid,
		        stage_name,
     is_bundled,
     lesson_id
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{dt}}}'
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		AND {{start_class_dt}}
		AND {{subject_id as subject}} 
	) a
	JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        CASE WHEN season_type = '12_month' THEN '年课'
		             WHEN season_type = '24_month' THEN '两年课'  ELSE season_type END AS season_type,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_dt AS season_pay_dt,
      from_unixtime(pay_tp / 1000) AS pay_tp,
		        cast(pay_tp AS bigint) AS season_pay_time,
		        CASE WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%banmatmall%' THEN '天猫'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-xcx%' or keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-app%' THEN '召回直播'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-sph%' THEN '召回视频号'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'referral-yxzz_live-%' THEN '0转正直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'cxc-yxzz_live-%' THEN '长续长直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'app-live-%' THEN 'app营销直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-jdkechengpop%' THEN '京东电商'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-douyin%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dy%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dyxd%' THEN '抖音电商'  ELSE '其他' END AS season_from,
		        keyfrom_cov,
		        pay_amt
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{dt}}}'
		AND semester_type = 'season'
		AND order_status = 2 
	) b
	ON a.userid = b.user_id AND a.renewal_orderid = b.order_id
) a

--7531 素质体验课用户维度
SELECT  distinct period_type AS `期数`,
        class_type AS `课程模式`,
        a.ldap AS `ldap`,
        a.leader_ldap AS `组长ldap`,
        stage_name AS `级别`,
        a.userid AS `userid`,
        user_from AS `渠道`,
        ad_channel AS `二级渠道`,

        if(b.userid is not null,'复购','首购') AS `是否复购`,
        user_city_type AS `城市类型`,
        age_buy_lesson_type AS `年龄`,
        season_subject_num AS `体验课前购买系统课科目数`,
        season_type AS `是否续报`,
        buy_season_dt AS `续报日期`,
        is_add_cur_teacher_wechat AS `是否添加`,
        is_active AS `是否激活`,
        d1_fin AS `d1当日完课`,
        d2_fin AS `d2当日完课`,
        d3_fin AS `d3当日完课`,
        d4_fin AS `d4当日完课`,
        coalesce(total_cnt,0) AS `总沟通次数`,
        coalesce(dial_cnt,0) AS `系统电话沟通次数`,
        avg_dial_duration AS `系统电话平均时长`
FROM
( -- 体验课基本信 息
	SELECT  user_id as userid,
	        teacher_ldap as ldap,
	        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
	        period_type,
	        user_city_type,
	        user_from,
	        ad_channel,
	        age_buy_lesson_type,
	        order_label as order_label_new,
	        stage_name,
	        pay_amt as paidfee,
	        is_add_wechat as is_add_cur_teacher_wechat,
	        is_current_active as is_active,
	        semester_id as semesterid,
	        team_leader_ldap as leader_ldap,
	        if(experiment_tag = '','大盘','实验组') AS class_type,
	        CASE WHEN is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_season_type = '12_month' THEN concat('已续报年课-',renewal_order_stage_name)
	             WHEN is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_season_type = '24_month' THEN '已续报两年课'  ELSE '未续报' END AS season_type,
	        renewal_order_pay_dt as buy_season_dt,
	        is_should_renewal,
	        is_renewal,
	        if(order_label = '未购课',0,size(split(order_label,'-'))) AS season_subject_num,
	        order_id as orderid
	FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND subject_id = '{{{subject}}}'
	AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-')[1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}} 
) a
LEFT JOIN
( -- 是否复 购
	SELECT  distinct user_id as userid,
	        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt
	FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND subject_id = '{{{subject}}}' 
) b
ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.start_class_dt < a.start_class_dt
LEFT JOIN
( -- 完 课
	SELECT  user_id,
	        semester_id,
	        subject_id,
	        CASE WHEN subject_id IN (4,7,8) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 5,is_finished_cur_day,null))
	             WHEN subject_id IN (5) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 1,is_finished_cur_day,null)) END AS d1_fin,
	        CASE WHEN subject_id IN (4,7,8) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 6,is_finished_cur_day,null))
	             WHEN subject_id IN (5) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 2,is_finished_cur_day,null)) END AS d2_fin,
	        CASE WHEN subject_id IN (8) THEN null
	             WHEN subject_id IN (4,7) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 7,is_finished_cur_day,null))
	             WHEN subject_id IN (5) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 3,is_finished_cur_day,null)) END AS d3_fin,
	        CASE WHEN subject_id IN (4,7) THEN null
	             WHEN subject_id IN (5) THEN MAX(if(day_idx = 4,is_finished_cur_day,null)) END AS d4_fin
	FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_mission_finish_data_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND subject_id = '{{{subject}}}'
	AND semester_type_cd = 'try'
	GROUP BY  user_id,
	          semester_id,
	          subject_id
) d
ON a.userid = d.user_id AND a.semesterid = d.semester_id
LEFT JOIN
( -- 沟 通
	SELECT  user_id AS userid,
	        ldap,
	        SUM(if(communication_via_cd = '3',interview_cnt,1)) AS total_cnt,
	        SUM(if(communication_via_cd = '3',interview_cnt,0)) AS dial_cnt,
	        round(SUM(duration)/SUM(interview_sucess_cnt),2) AS avg_dial_duration
	FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_mentor_work_interview_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	AND subject_id = '{{{subject}}}'
	GROUP BY  user_id,
	          ldap
) g
ON a.userid = g.userid AND a.ldap = g.ldap

--中价课退费数 
-- 模式：英语大盘、英语-轻服务（深度服务）、英语-独立分班（无服务）、思维、阅读、英思 
-- 期次 
-- 级别 
-- 开课进度 - 按W0-W1具体D/N拆分，W2/W3/W4之后 
-- 账号类型 - 取渠道来源定义的 
-- 在课年龄 
-- 断课时长 
-- 看哪些字段 
-- 期次用户数、总退费率/阶段退费率、退费前发生有效沟通行为的占比、退费前发生老师直播行为的占比、退费用户退前的完课率、退费前续报占比（*订单维度退费发生时间和系统课退费发生时间）
WITH detail AS
(
	SELECT  coalesce(CASE WHEN is_bundled = 1 THEN '英思联带' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 2 and lesson_id = 830  THEN '思维中价' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 3 and lesson_id = 870  THEN '阅读中价' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') AND (semester_tag LIKE '%实验C组%' or lesson_id = 800) THEN '英语中价-独立分班' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') AND semester_tag rlike '实验|对照' THEN '英语中价-深度服务' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') THEN '英语中价-大盘' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 1 AND semester_tag rlike '实验|对照' THEN '英语其他渠道-深度服务' WHEN is_bundled = 0 AND a.subject_id = 1 THEN '英语其他渠道-大盘' ELSE null END,CASE WHEN buy_way = '联报' AND a.subject_id IN ('1','2') AND has_eng = 1 AND has_math = 1 THEN '英思联带' WHEN a.subject_id = 2 and lesson_id = 830  THEN '思维中价' WHEN a.subject_id = 3 and lesson_id = 870  THEN '阅读中价'  WHEN a.subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带' WHEN a.subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' WHEN a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') AND (semester_tag LIKE '%实验C组%' or lesson_id = 800) THEN '英语中价-独立分班' WHEN a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') AND semester_tag rlike '实验|对照' THEN '英语中价-深度服务' WHEN a.subject_id = 1 AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价','点读版') THEN '英语中价-大盘' WHEN a.subject_id = 1 AND semester_tag rlike '实验|对照' THEN '英语其他渠道-深度服务' WHEN a.subject_id = 1 THEN '英语其他渠道-大盘' ELSE '其他' END ) AS mode,
	        a.start_class_dt,
	        s.end_class_dt,
	        a.user_id,
	        MAX(coalesce(s2.stage_name,s1.stage_name)) AS stage_name,
	        MAX(CASE WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') AND accountid is null or accountid = '' THEN '无账户' WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') AND accountid IN ('1822030030407690','1822027034104842','1822030131404891','1761605098022045','1761242332601421','1768215457237069','1773641570409549','1738048746778632','1786225457446027') THEN '拼接账户' WHEN ad_channel in ('抖音中价','腾讯中价','其他中价','电商中价') THEN '常规账户' ELSE '其他' END) AS account_type,
	        MAX(age_buy_lesson_type) AS age_buy_lesson_type,
	        MAX(a.pay_dt) AS pay_dt,
	        MAX(s.parent_semester_id) AS parent_semester_id,
	        MAX(if(is_season = 1,1,0)) AS is_season,
	        MAX(refund_dt) AS refund_dt,
	        MIN(if(is_finish_end = 1,1,0)) AS is_finish_end,
	        MAX(if(m.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_after_season,
	        MAX(if(n.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_before_season,
	        MAX(validation) AS validation,
	        MAX(if(is_gou = 1,1,0)) AS is_gou,
	        MAX(j.end_class_dt) AS pre_end_class_dt,
	        MAX(if(f.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_live
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  
		        user_id,
		        semesterid,
		        start_class_dt,
		        order_id,
		        parent_order_id,
		        subject_id,
		        keyfrom,
		        refund_dt,
		        refund_tp,
		        pay_dt,
		        pay_tp,
		        age_buy_lesson_type,
		        ad_channel,
		        buy_way,
		        has_eng,
		        has_math,
		        classid,
		        teacherid,
		        ldap,
		        is_finish_end,
		        is_season
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  
			        user_id,
			        order_id,
			        pay_dt,
			        pay_tp,
			        subject_id,
			        parent_order_id,
			        keyfrom,
			        order_status,
			        start_class_dt,
			        age_buy_lesson_type,
			        ad_channel,
			        buy_way,
			        has_eng,
			        has_math,
			        semesterid,
			        classid,
			        teacherid,
			        ldap,
			        refund_dt,
			        refund_tp,
			        is_finish_end,
			        is_season,
			        dt,
			        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.order_id ORDER BY  dt DESC) AS rk
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  
				        user_id,
				        order_id,
				        pay_dt,
				        pay_tp,
				        subject_id,
				        parent_order_id,
				        keyfrom,
				        order_status,
				        start_class_dt,
				        age_buy_lesson_type,
				        ad_channel,
				        buy_way,
				        has_eng,
				        has_math,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        refund_dt,
				        refund_tp
			FROM
			(
				SELECT 
				        a.user_id,
				        a.order_id,
				        a.pay_dt,
				        a.pay_tp,
				        a.subject_id,
				        a.parent_order_id,
				        a.keyfrom,
				        a.order_status,
				        a.start_class_dt,
				        a.age_buy_lesson_type,
				        a.ad_channel,
				        buy_way,
				        has_eng,
				        has_math,
				        b.semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        if(c.refund_dt is not null,c.refund_dt,null) AS refund_dt,
				        if(c.refund_tp is not null,c.refund_tp,null) AS refund_tp,
				        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.user_id,a.start_class_dt,a.subject_id ORDER BY  coalesce(c.refund_dt,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  a.user_id,
					        a.order_id,
					        a.pay_dt,
					        a.pay_tp,
					        a.subject_id,
					        a.parent_order_id,
					        a.keyfrom,
					        a.order_status,
					        a.refund_related_weekcount,
					        a.start_class_dt,
					        age_buy_lesson_type,
					        ad_channel,
					        buy_way,
					        has_eng,
					        has_math
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  user_id,
						        order_id,
						        pay_dt,
						        pay_tp,
						        subject_id,
						        parent_order_id,
						        keyfrom,
						        order_status,
						        refund_related_weekcount,
						        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
						        lesson_id
						FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
						WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
						AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}} 
					)a
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  user_id,
						        order_id,
						        CASE WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 0 AND age_buy_lesson < 2 THEN '0-2岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 2 AND age_buy_lesson < 3 THEN '2-3岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 3 AND age_buy_lesson < 4 THEN '3-4岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 4 AND age_buy_lesson < 5 THEN '4-5岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 5 AND age_buy_lesson < 6 THEN '5-6岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 6 AND age_buy_lesson < 7 THEN '6-7岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 7 AND age_buy_lesson < 8 THEN '7-8岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 8 AND age_buy_lesson < 9 THEN '8-9岁'
						             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 9 THEN '9岁以上'  ELSE '未设置' END AS age_buy_lesson_type,
						        ad_channel,
						        buy_way
						FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_trade_try_double_order_from_info_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
					)b
					ON a.order_id = b.order_id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  parent_order_id,
						        MAX(if(subject_id = 1,1,null)) AS has_eng,
						        MAX(if(subject_id = 2,1,null)) AS has_math
						FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
						AND order_status >= 2
						AND order_id != parent_order_id -- 父订单和子订单不是同一个订单
						GROUP BY  parent_order_id
					)c
					ON a.parent_order_id = c.parent_order_id
				) a
				LEFT JOIN
				( -- 订单 表
					SELECT  b.*,
					        orderid,
					        ldap
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  orderid,
						        userid,
						        id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
						WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
					) a
					JOIN
					( -- 分班 表
						SELECT  userid,
						        semesterid,
						        classid,
						        teacherid,
						        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
						        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND lessonid IN ('126', '122', '70', '800','830','870')
						AND type = 1
						AND status <> 3 
					) b
					ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
						        tf.key AS teacherid
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
					)c
					ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
				) b
				ON a.order_id = b.orderid
				LEFT JOIN
				( -- 退款 表
					SELECT  order_id,
					        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
					        refund_tp,
					        refundment_type_name
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
					AND refund_status_code = 2 -- 成功
					AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
				) c
				ON a.order_id = c.order_id
			)a
			WHERE rk = 1 
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id as userid,
			        order_id as orderid,
			        is_finish_end_class as is_finish_end,
			        is_renewal as is_season,
			        dt,
			        end_class_dt
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt BETWEEN date_sub(start_class_dt, 21) AND date_add(end_class_dt, 14)
			AND {{start_class_dt}} 
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		) d
		ON a.order_id = d.orderid AND refund_dt is not null AND d.dt <= a.refund_dt
	)a
	WHERE rk = 1 
)a
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  semester_id,
	        parent_semester_id,
	        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
	        is_bundled,
	        subject_id AS subject,
	        end_class_dt,
	        lesson_id
	FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
) s
ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  parent_order_id,
	        concat_ws(',',sort_array(collect_list(stage_name))) AS stage_name
	FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
	WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
	AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
	GROUP BY  parent_order_id
) s1
ON a.parent_order_id = s1.parent_order_id
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  parent_semester_id,
	        concat_ws(',',sort_array(collect_list(start_stage_name))) AS stage_name
	FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	GROUP BY  parent_semester_id
) s2
ON s.parent_semester_id = s2.parent_semester_id
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  user_id,
	        order_id,
	        pay_dt,
	        subject_id,
	        pay_tp,
	        first_refund_tp,
	        first_refund_dt,
	        refund_related_weekcount
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,
		        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
		        refund_related_weekcount
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND semester_type IN ('season')
		AND order_status >= 2 
	) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  renewal_order_id as renewal_orderid
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND is_renewal = 1 
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'
	)b
	ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
	WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
)m
ON a.user_id = m.user_id AND a.subject_id = m.subject_id AND m.pay_tp > a.refund_tp AND a.refund_tp is not null AND m.pay_dt <= date_add(s.end_class_dt, 7) AND (m.first_refund_tp is null or m.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or m.first_refund_dt > date_add(s.end_class_dt, 14))
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  userid,
	        classid,
	        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
	FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	GROUP BY  userid,
	          classid
)t
ON a.user_id = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  user_id,
	        order_id,
	        pay_dt,
	        subject_id,
	        pay_tp,
	        first_refund_tp,
	        first_refund_dt,
	        refund_related_weekcount
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,
		        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
		        refund_related_weekcount
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND semester_type IN ('season')
		AND order_status >= 2 
	) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  renewal_order_id as renewal_orderid
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND is_renewal = 1 
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'
	)b
	ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
	WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
)n
ON a.user_id = n.user_id AND a.subject_id = n.subject_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND a.refund_tp is not null AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(s.end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(s.end_class_dt, 14))
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  userid,
	        ldap,
	        from_unixtime(int(createdtime/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS create_dt,
	        MAX(validation) AS validation,
	        MAX(1) AS is_gou
	FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_task_interview_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	GROUP BY  userid,
	          ldap,
	          from_unixtime(int(createdtime/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd')
)e
ON a.user_id = e.userid AND a.ldap = e.ldap AND a.refund_dt is not null AND e.create_dt <= a.refund_dt AND create_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 14)
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  user_id,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        from_unixtime(int(start_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_dt

		WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND {{start_class_dt}}
		AND ((subject_id IN (2) AND stage_name = 'S4' ) or (subject_id IN (3) AND stage_name = 'S5' ))
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'

		AND semester_type_cd = 'try_double'
		AND ((subject_id IN (2) AND stage_name = 'S4' ) or (subject_id IN (3) AND stage_name = 'S5' ))
		AND day_idx = 5
		AND mission_type_cd in('19', '4')

  where {{a.subject_id}}

  a.subject_id,

	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1,exam_score,0)) AS w1_exam_score,

select 
	coalesce(dt,'total_count')as dt,
    coalesce(appid,'total_count')as  appid,
    coalesce(resource_type,'total_count')as resource_type,
    coalesce(case when b.user_id is not null then '买过衍生品'
    else '没买过衍生品' end,'total_count')as yanshengpin_type
    ,count(distinct userid)as unt 
from 
(
	select

		case when url in ('/event/SplashScreen/enter') then '闪屏'
			when url in ('/expose/MarketingPopup/enter',
				'/event/AppPopWindow/enter') then '弹窗'
			when url in ('/expose/LessonList/banner',
	            '/expose/HdHomepage/banner',
	            '/event/LessonList/Banner/enter',
                  '/expose/LessonList/recommend/banner') then 'banner'
			when url in ('/expose/LessonList/custom',
            '/expose/LessonList/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/moreinfo')and appid='pedia' then '百科货架'
		
			when url in ('/expose/PediaPackagelistPage/banner',
            -- 货架
            '/expose/LessonList/custom',
            '/expose/LessonList/shelves',
            '/expose/ExtensiveStudying/card',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/moreinfo',
            '/expose/PediaPackagelistPage/GoodsPackage')and appid='zebra' then '斑马拓展入口'
			when url in ('/expose/HdHomepage/launchAd',
				
            '/expose/LessonList/launchAd') then '上新卡片'
			else url end as resource_type,
			a.*

		  
	from 
	(	-- 百科资源位
    select dt,action_tp,url,userid
            ,'' as buymode
            ,'' as keyfrom
            ,'' as duration
            ,'pedia' as appid
            ,productid
            ,device_type
    from dw_ods.ods_pedia_frog
    where dt between '{{{start_dt}}}' and '{{{end_dt}}}'
    and url in('/event/SplashScreen/enter',
            '/expose/MarketingPopup/enter',
            '/expose/LessonList/banner',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/banner',
            '/expose/LessonList/recommend/banner',
            -- 百科货架
            '/expose/LessonList/custom',
            '/expose/LessonList/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/moreinfo',

            -- 上新卡片
            '/expose/HdHomepage/launchAd',
            '/expose/LessonList/launchAd'

            )
    AND category IN ('click','event','expose')
    AND page_tp IN ('S','M','L','H','E')
    and ( {{other['taskid']}}
    		or {{other['id']}}
    	-- 弹窗
        or  {{other['popupid'] }}
        -- 货架
        or {{other['cardid']}}
        or {{other['packageid']}}
        -- 上新卡片
        or {{other['resourceid']}}
        or {{other['materialid']}}
        or {{other['bannerid'] as bkbannerid}}
        )

    -- 斑马资源位
    union all
    select dt,action_tp,url,user_id as userid
        ,'' as buymode
        ,'' as keyfrom
        ,'' as duration
        ,'zebra' as appid
        ,product_id
        ,device_type
    from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_frog_di
    where dt between '{{{start_dt}}}' and '{{{end_dt}}}'
    and url in('/event/SplashScreen/enter',
            '/event/AppPopWindow/enter',
            '/event/LessonList/Banner/enter',

            -- 拓展入口
            '/expose/PediaPackagelistPage/banner', 	-- 外部卡片

            -- 货架
            '/expose/LessonList/custom',
            '/expose/LessonList/shelves',
            '/expose/ExtensiveStudying/card',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/shelves',
            '/expose/HdHomepage/moreinfo',
            -- 老版货架
            '/event/PediaPackagelistPage/PediaPackageCard/enter',
            '/expose/PediaPackagelistPage/GoodsPackage',

            -- 上新卡片
            '/expose/HdHomepage/launchAd',
            '/expose/LessonList/launchAd'

            )
    AND category IN ('click','event','expose')
    AND page_tp IN ('S','M','L','H','A','E','P')
    and ( {{other['taskid']}} 
    		or {{other['id']}}
    	-- 弹窗
        or {{other['resourceid']}} 

        -- 拓展入口
        or {{other['bannerid']}} 
        -- 货架
        or {{other['cardid']}} 
        or {{other['packageid']}}   

        -- 上新卡片
        or {{other['resourceid']}}
        or {{other['materialid']}}
        )
	)a 
	
)detail 
left join 
(--衍生品成单
    select user_id,min(pay_tp) as shougou_tp 
    from dw_conan_dwd.dwd_pedia_derivative_order_info_da
    where dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
    and order_status_cd = 2
    and is_test_user = 0
    group by user_id
) b 
on detail.userid=b.user_id
and detail.action_tp>b.shougou_tp
group by 
		dt,
	    appid,
	    resource_type
        ,case when b.user_id is not null then '买过衍生品'
    else '没买过衍生品' end with cube

WITH users AS
(
	SELECT  a.user_id,
	        a.teacher_ldap,
	        a.start_class_dt,
	        a.semester_id,
	        a.is_renewal,
	        teacher_city,
	        renewal_order_pay_dt,
	        a.end_class_dt,
	        a.subject_id,
	        a.stage_name,
	        semester_tag,
	        is_attend_first_day,
	        is_finish_end_class,
	        w1d1_fin,
	        w1d2_fin,
	        w1d3_fin,
	        w1d4_fin,
	        w2d1_fin,
	        w2d2_fin,
	        w2d3_fin,
	        w2d4_fin,
	        is_enter_1v1,
	        week_idx,
	        mission_id,
	        mission_type_cd,
	        push_dt
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.user_id,
		        a.teacher_ldap,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        a.semester_id,
		        a.is_renewal,
		        teacher_city,
		        renewal_order_pay_dt,
		        a.end_class_dt,
		        a.subject_id,
		        a.stage_name,
		        semester_tag,
		        is_attend_first_day,
		        is_finish_end_class,
		        w1d1_fin,
		        w1d2_fin,
		        w1d3_fin,
		        w1d4_fin,
		        w2d1_fin,
		        w2d2_fin,
		        w2d3_fin,
		        w2d4_fin,
		        MAX(if(c.user_id is not null AND CAST(c.first_enter_time AS BIGINT) > 0 AND CAST(c.valid_watch_time AS BIGINT) > 0,1,0)) AS is_enter_1v1
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        start_class_dt,
			        semester_id,
			        if(is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0) AS is_renewal,
			        renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        end_class_dt,
			        subject_id,
			        stage_name,
			        teacher_city,
			        is_attend_first_day,
			        is_finish_end_class,
			        CASE WHEN experiment_tag rLIKE 'B' THEN '深度服务'  ELSE '标准服务' END AS semester_tag
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (1)
			AND stage_name IN ('S5', 'S6')
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			AND is_bundled = '单带'
			AND lesson_id != 800 
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        semester_id,
			        if(w1d1_rec > 0 AND w1d1_rec = w1d1_fin,1,0) AS w1d1_fin,
			        if(w1d2_rec > 0 AND w1d2_rec = w1d2_fin,1,0) AS w1d2_fin,
			        if(w1d3_rec > 0 AND w1d3_rec = w1d3_fin,1,0) AS w1d3_fin,
			        if(w1d4_rec > 0 AND w1d4_rec = w1d4_fin,1,0) AS w1d4_fin,
			        if(w2d1_rec > 0 AND w2d1_rec = w2d1_fin,1,0) AS w2d1_fin,
			        if(w2d2_rec > 0 AND w2d2_rec = w2d2_fin,1,0) AS w2d2_fin,
			        if(w2d3_rec > 0 AND w2d3_rec = w2d3_fin,1,0) AS w2d3_fin,
			        if(w2d4_rec > 0 AND w2d4_rec = w2d4_fin,1,0) AS w2d4_fin
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        semester_id,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d1_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 2,mission_id,null)) AS w1d2_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 3,mission_id,null)) AS w1d3_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 4,mission_id,null)) AS w1d4_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d1_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 2,mission_id,null)) AS w2d2_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 3,mission_id,null)) AS w2d3_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 4,mission_id,null)) AS w2d4_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 1 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d1_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 2 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d2_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 3 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d3_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 4 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d4_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 1 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d1_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 2 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d2_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 3 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d3_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 4 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d4_fin
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  user_id,
					        semester_id,
					        stage_week_idx,
					        day_idx,
					        mission_id,
					        is_finished_cur_day
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_mission_finish_data_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
					AND semester_type_cd IN ('try_double')
					AND start_class_dt >= '2022-06-01' 
				) a
				GROUP BY  user_id,
				          semester_id
			) a
		) b
		ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.semester_id = b.semester_id
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        teacher_ldap,
			        first_enter_time,
			        from_unixtime(int(start_time/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_dt,
			        valid_watch_time
			FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_service_live_user_class_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND sky_episode_business_type IN ('2', '7') 
		)c
		ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.teacher_ldap = c.teacher_ldap AND c.start_dt >= date_sub(a.start_class_dt, 28) AND c.start_dt <= a.end_class_dt
		GROUP BY  a.user_id,
		          a.teacher_ldap,
		          a.start_class_dt,
		          a.semester_id,
		          a.is_renewal,
		          teacher_city,
		          renewal_order_pay_dt,
		          a.end_class_dt,
		          a.subject_id,
		          a.stage_name,
		          semester_tag,
		          is_attend_first_day,
		          is_finish_end_class,
		          w1d1_fin,
		          w1d2_fin,
		          w1d3_fin,
		          w1d4_fin,
		          w2d1_fin,
		          w2d2_fin,
		          w2d3_fin,
		          w2d4_fin
	) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  userid,
		        week_idx,
		        semester_id,
		        mission_id,
		        mission_type_cd,
		        push_dt
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_mission_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND is_test = '0'
		AND {{start_class_dt}}
		AND semester_type_cd = 'try_double'
		AND subject_id IN (1)
		AND stage_name IN ('S5', 'S6')
		AND mission_type_cd in('19', '4') 
	) b
	ON a.user_id = b.userid AND a.semester_id = b.semester_id
), exam_detail AS
(
	SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
	        a.subject_id,
	        a.stage_name,
	        a.end_class_dt,
	        a.user_id,
	        is_renewal,
	        renewal_order_pay_dt,
	        is_enter_1v1,
	        semester_tag,
	        teacher_city,
	        is_attend_first_day,
	        is_finish_end_class,
	        w1d1_fin,
	        w1d2_fin,
	        w1d3_fin,
	        w1d4_fin,
	        w2d1_fin,
	        w2d2_fin,
	        w2d3_fin,
	        w2d4_fin,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1,exam_score,0)) AS w1_exam_score,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1,question_cnt,0)) AS w1_question_cnt,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1,exam_score,0))/MAX(if(week_idx = 1,question_cnt,0)) AS w1_score,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2,exam_score,0)) AS w2_exam_score,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2,question_cnt,0)) AS w2_question_cnt,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2,exam_score,0))/MAX(if(week_idx = 2,question_cnt,0)) AS w2_score,
	        SUM(exam_score) AS exam_score,
	        SUM(question_cnt) AS question_cnt,
	        SUM(exam_score)/SUM(question_cnt) AS score,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1,show_dt,0)) AS w1_show_dt,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2,show_dt,0)) AS w2_show_dt,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt = show_dt,1,0)) AS w1_attend_cur,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt = show_dt,1,0)) AS w2_attend_cur,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= date_sub(end_class_dt,6),1,0)) AS w1_attend_w2d1,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= date_sub(end_class_dt,6),1,0)) AS w2_attend_w2d1,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w1_attend_end,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w2_attend_end,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND attend_status > 0,1,0)) AS w1_attend,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND attend_status > 0,1,0)) AS w2_attend,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt = show_dt,1,0)) AS w1_finish_cur,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt = show_dt,1,0)) AS w2_finish_cur,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= date_sub(end_class_dt,6),1,0)) AS w1_finish_w2d1,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= date_sub(end_class_dt,6),1,0)) AS w2_finish_w2d1,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w1_finish_end,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w2_finish_end,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND finish_status > 0,1,0)) AS w1_finish,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 2 AND finish_status > 0,1,0)) AS w2_finish
	FROM users a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        exam_source_id,
		        user_id,
		        week_num,
		        show_dt,
		        MAX(finish_status) AS finish_status,
		        MAX(attend_status) AS attend_status,
		        MIN(first_enter_dt) AS first_enter_dt,
		        MIN(finish_exam_dt) AS finish_exam_dt,
		        MAX(exam_score) AS exam_score,
		        MAX(question_cnt) AS question_cnt
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_exam_report_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND subject_id IN (1)
		AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}}
		AND exam_type = '1001'
		AND exam_resource_finish_rk = 1
		GROUP BY  regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-'),
		          subject_id,
		          exam_source_id,
		          user_id,
		          week_num,
		          show_dt
	)c
	ON a.start_class_dt = c.start_class_dt AND a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.mission_id = c.exam_source_id AND a.mission_type_cd = '19' AND a.subject_id = c.subject_id
	GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
	          a.subject_id,
	          a.stage_name,
	          a.end_class_dt,
	          a.user_id,
	          is_renewal,
	          renewal_order_pay_dt,
	          is_enter_1v1,
	          semester_tag,
	          teacher_city,
	          is_attend_first_day,
	          is_finish_end_class,
	          w1d1_fin,
	          w1d2_fin,
	          w1d3_fin,
	          w1d4_fin,
	          w2d1_fin,
	          w2d2_fin,
	          w2d3_fin,
	          w2d4_fin
) , tv_detail AS
(
	SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
	        a.subject_id,
	        a.stage_name,
	        a.end_class_dt,
	        a.user_id,
	        is_renewal,
	        renewal_order_pay_dt,
	        is_enter_1v1,
	        semester_tag,
	        teacher_city,
	        is_attend_first_day,
	        is_finish_end_class,
	        w1d1_fin,
	        w1d2_fin,
	        w1d3_fin,
	        w1d4_fin,
	        w2d1_fin,
	        w2d2_fin,
	        w2d3_fin,
	        w2d4_fin,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND (is_watched > 0 or (is_playback > 0 AND play_back_dt <= a.push_dt)),1,0)) AS w1_attend_cur,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND (is_watched > 0 or (is_playback > 0 AND play_back_dt <= date_sub(end_class_dt,6))),1,0)) AS w1_attend_w2d1,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND (is_watched > 0 or (is_playback > 0 AND play_back_dt <= a.end_class_dt)),1,0)) AS w1_attend_end,
	        MAX(if(week_idx = 1 AND (is_watched > 0 or is_playback > 0),1,0)) AS w1_attend
	FROM users a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        subject_id,
		        mission_id,
		        room_id,
		        SUM(is_watched) AS is_watched,
		        SUM(is_playback) AS is_playback
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_watch_tv_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND subject_id IN (1)
		AND stage_name IN ('S5')
		AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}}
		GROUP BY  user_id,
		          subject_id,
		          mission_id,
		          room_id
	)c
	ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND a.mission_id = c.mission_id AND a.mission_type_cd = '4' AND a.subject_id = c.subject_id AND a.stage_name IN ('S5')
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  userid AS user_id,
		        subject,
		        roomid AS room_id,
		        FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(MIN(tp) / 1000 AS INT),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS play_back_dt
		FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_course_tv_playback_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND subject IN (1)
		GROUP BY  userid,
		          subject,
		          roomid
	)d
	ON c.user_id = d.user_id AND c.room_id = d.room_id AND c.subject_id = d.subject
	GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
	          a.subject_id,
	          a.stage_name,
	          a.end_class_dt,
	          a.user_id,
	          is_renewal,
	          renewal_order_pay_dt,
	          is_enter_1v1,
	          semester_tag,
	          teacher_city,
	          is_attend_first_day,
	          is_finish_end_class,
	          w1d1_fin,
	          w1d2_fin,
	          w1d3_fin,
	          w1d4_fin,
	          w2d1_fin,
	          w2d2_fin,
	          w2d3_fin,
	          w2d4_fin
)
SELECT  'W1周测' AS `周测时间`,
        start_class_dt AS `期次`,
        stage_name AS `级别`,
        coalesce(teacher_city,'汇总') AS `城市`,
        coalesce(is_enter_1v1,'汇总') AS `是否参加1v1`,
        coalesce(semester_tag,'汇总') AS `模式`,
        coalesce(w1_attend,'汇总') AS `是否参加周测`,
        coalesce(w1_finish,'汇总') AS `是否完成周测`,
        coalesce(CASE WHEN w1_score >= 0 AND w1_score < 0.6 THEN '不及格' WHEN w1_score >= 0.6 AND w1_score < 0.8 THEN '及格' WHEN w1_score >= 0.8 AND w1_score <= 1 THEN '优秀' ELSE '未知' END,'汇总') AS `分数水平`,
        COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `用户数`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_cur = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `当日参与率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_w2d1 = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D1参与率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_end = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D7参与率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_finish_cur = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `当日完成率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_finish_w2d1 = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D1完成率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_finish_end = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D7完成率`,
        SUM(w1_exam_score)/SUM(w1_question_cnt) AS `分数`,

        COUNT(distinct if(w1_finish_end = 1 AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct if(w1_finish_end = 1,user_id,null)) AS `截止W2D7周测完成转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_attend_first_day = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `首日到课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_finish_end_class = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `总完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止w2d7转化率`
FROM exam_detail
GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
          stage_name,
          cube (teacher_city,is_enter_1v1,semester_tag,w1_attend,w1_finish,CASE WHEN w1_score >= 0 AND w1_score < 0.6 THEN '不及格' WHEN w1_score >= 0.6 AND w1_score < 0.8 THEN '及格' WHEN w1_score >= 0.8 AND w1_score <= 1 THEN '优秀' ELSE '未知' END)

          cube (teacher_city,is_enter_1v1,semester_tag,if(w1_attend = 1 AND w2_attend = 1,1,0),if(w1_finish = 1 AND w2_finish = 1,1,0),CASE WHEN score >= 0 AND score < 0.6 THEN '不及格' WHEN score >= 0.6 AND score < 0.8 THEN '及格' WHEN score >= 0.8 AND score <= 1 THEN '优秀' ELSE '未知' END)
UNION ALL
SELECT  'W1 TV课' AS `周测时间`,
        start_class_dt AS `期次`,
        stage_name AS `级别`,
        coalesce(teacher_city,'汇总') AS `城市`,
        coalesce(is_enter_1v1,'汇总') AS `是否参加1v1`,
        coalesce(semester_tag,'汇总') AS `模式`,
        coalesce(w1_attend,'汇总') AS `是否参加周测`,
        '汇总' AS `是否完成周测`,
        '汇总' AS `分数水平`,
        COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `用户数`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_cur = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `当日参与率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_w2d1 = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D1参与率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1_attend_end = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D7参与率`,
        0 AS `当日完成率`,
        0 AS `截止W2D1完成率`,
        0 AS `截止W2D7完成率`,
        0 AS `分数`,
        0 AS `及格率`,
        0 AS `优秀率`,
        0 AS `当日周测完成转化率`,
        0 AS `截止W2D7周测完成转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_attend_first_day = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `首日到课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_finish_end_class = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `总完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止w2d7转化率`
FROM tv_detail
GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
          stage_name,
          cube (teacher_city,is_enter_1v1,semester_tag,w1_attend)
