file_content:
-- 甩班平台申请与分配记录

SET hive.mapred.mode = nostrict;

WITH final_assignee_r1 AS (
    SELECT  throwclassapplicationid,
            classid,
            CASE WHEN approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE assigneeldap END AS final_assigneeldap
    FROM
    (
        SELECT  b.throwclassapplicationid,
                b.classid,
                b.approvalstatus,
                c.assigneeldap,
                row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY b.classid ORDER BY fenpei_time DESC) AS fenpei_rk
        FROM
        (
            SELECT  applicant,
                    reason,
                    dbctime,
                    id
            FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_application_da
            WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
            GROUP BY  applicant,
                      reason,
                      dbctime,
                      id
        ) a0
        JOIN
        (
            SELECT  id,
                    classid,
                    subject,
                    applicant,
                    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdatelatest, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdatelatest,
                    from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdate,
                    assigneeldap,
                    approvalstatus,
                    matchstatus,
                    latestmatchrecordid,
                    throwclassapplicationid,
                    throwclasstype,
                    to_date(dbctime) AS dbctime
            FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_request_da
            WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
            AND {{from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}
            GROUP BY  id,
                      classid,
                      subject,
                      applicant,
                      from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdatelatest, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                      from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                      assigneeldap,
                      approvalstatus,
                      matchstatus,
                      latestmatchrecordid,
                      throwclassapplicationid,
                      throwclasstype,
                      to_date(dbctime)
        ) b
        ON a0.applicant = b.applicant AND a0.id = b.throwclassapplicationid
        LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT  classid,
                    throwclassrequestid,
                    assigneeldap,
                    fenpei_time
            FROM
            (
                SELECT  id,
                        type,
                        throwclassmatchtaskid,
                        throwclassrequestid,
                        classid,
                        assigneeldap,
                        confirmstatus,
                        from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdate,
                        to_date(dbctime) AS allocate_dt,
                        dbctime AS fenpei_time,
                        throwstatus,
                        matchinfo,
                        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY throwclassmatchtaskid, classid, assigneeldap ORDER BY cast(id AS INT) DESC) AS rk
                FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_match_record_da
                WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
                AND {{from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}
                GROUP BY  id,
                          type,
                          throwclassmatchtaskid,
                          throwclassrequestid,
                          classid,
                          assigneeldap,
                          confirmstatus,
                          from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                          to_date(dbctime),
                          dbctime,
                          throwstatus,
                          matchinfo
            ) m0
            WHERE {{allocate_dt}}
            AND rk = 1
        ) c
        ON b.classid = c.classid
        AND b.id = c.throwclassrequestid
    ) z
    WHERE z.fenpei_rk = 1
),
throw_group_pack AS (
    SELECT  grp.application_id,
            grp.class_ids,
            CASE
                WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fa.final_assigneeldap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 0
                WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT fa.final_assigneeldap) = 1 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS is_throw_group_pack_assign_ok
    FROM
    (
        SELECT  DISTINCT
                s.application_id,
                s.class_ids,
                s.cid_str
        FROM
        (
            SELECT  g.application_id,
                    g.class_ids,
                    trim(elem) AS cid_str
            FROM dw_conan_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_group_da g
            LATERAL VIEW explode(split(trim(regexp_replace(g.class_ids, '\\[|\\]', '')), ',')) e AS elem
            WHERE g.dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
            AND g.status = 1
        ) s
        WHERE trim(s.cid_str) <> ''
    ) grp
    LEFT JOIN final_assignee_r1 fa
    ON fa.throwclassapplicationid = grp.application_id
    AND cast(fa.classid AS STRING) = trim(grp.cid_str)
    GROUP BY  grp.application_id,
              grp.class_ids
)

SELECT  classid,
CASE 
			WHEN subject = '1' THEN '英语'
			WHEN subject = '2' THEN '思维'
			WHEN subject = '3' THEN '阅读'
			WHEN subject = '4' THEN '美术'
			WHEN subject = '5' THEN '写字'
			WHEN subject = '7' THEN '音乐'
			WHEN subject = '8' THEN '科学'
			ELSE subject
		END AS subject,
        stage_name,
        week,
        user_num,
        applicant,
        teacher_leader_ldap,
        app_district_leader_ldap,
        teacher_city,
        case when reason='depart' then '离职'
        when reason='transfer' then '转岗'
        when reason='pregnant' then '产假'
        when reason='tempLeave' then '请假'
        when reason='special' then '特殊情况'
        when reason='waiting4ex' then '等待长续带原班'
        when reason='freeze' then '冻结'
        when reason='pip' then 'PIP'
        when reason='longVacation' then '长假'
        else reason end as reason,
        application_date,
        throwclassdatelatest,
        throwclassdate,
        stage_weekidx,
        match_date,
        matchstatus,
        throwclasstype,
        approvalstatus,
        assigneeldap,
        team_leader_ldap,
        district_leader_ldap,
        mentor_org_city,
        confirmstatus,
        reject_reason,
        throwstatus,
        alloc_strategy_display AS `分配方式`,
        is_throw_takeover_same_city AS `接班老师与甩班老师是否同城`,
        is_throw_early_effective AS `班级是否提前生效`,
        class_layer_type_display AS `班级分层类型`,
        is_takeover_has_same_progress_class AS `接班老师是否有同进度班级`,
        throw_class_group_class_ids AS `甩班组ID`,
        is_throw_group_pack_assign_ok AS `甩班组打包分配是否成功`,
        throw_class_group_layer_display AS `甩班组分层类型`,
		CASE WHEN fenpei_rk=1 then '是' else '否' end as is_last_fenpei
        
FROM
(
	SELECT  b.classid,
	b.subject,
	        -- 班级id
 			d.stage_name,-- 级别
	        d.stage_weekidx AS week,--week
	        d.user_num,-- 班级人数
	        b.applicant,-- 甩班老师ldap
	        d.teacher_leader_ldap,--甩班老师组长
	        d.district_leader_ldap AS app_district_leader_ldap,-- 甩班老师分区
	        d.teacher_city,-- 甩班老师城市
	        a.reason,-- 甩班原因
	        to_date(a.dbctime) AS application_date,-- 申请日期
	        b.throwclassdatelatest,-- 最晚生效日期
	        b.throwclassdate,-- 实际生效日期
	        e.stage_weekidx,--实际生效时Week
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE allocate_dt END AS match_date,-- 分配日期（驳回/撤回时置空）
	        fenpei_time,
	        CASE WHEN b.matchstatus = 0 THEN '初始状态(还未审批通过或已驳回, 无需执行甩班匹配)'
	             WHEN b.matchstatus = 10 THEN '待匹配(已审批通过,可开始甩班匹配)'
	             WHEN b.matchstatus = 11 THEN '匹配中'
	             WHEN b.matchstatus = 20 THEN '已匹配承接老师'
	             WHEN b.matchstatus = 30 THEN '已过期-超过匹配时间还未匹配'  ELSE 'unknown' END AS matchstatus,-- 甩班请求匹配状态
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus = 10 THEN '审批中'
	             WHEN b.approvalstatus = 20 THEN '已通过'
	             WHEN b.approvalstatus = 30 THEN '已驳回'
	             WHEN b.approvalstatus = 40 THEN '老师已撤回'  ELSE 'unknown' END AS approvalstatus,-- 甩班申请审批状态
	        case
	        	when b.throwclasstype='poor' then '差班'
	        	when b.throwclasstype='normal' then '正常班'
	        	else 'unknown' 
	        END AS throwclasstype,-- 甩班请求班级类型
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE c.assigneeldap END AS assigneeldap,-- 接班老师ldap（驳回/撤回时置空）
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE f.team_leader_ldap END AS team_leader_ldap,-- 接班老师组长
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE f.district_leader_ldap END AS district_leader_ldap,-- 接班老师分区
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL ELSE f.mentor_org_city END AS mentor_org_city,-- 接班老师城市
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL
	             WHEN c.confirmstatus = 0 THEN '初始状态(匹配失败,无需承接)'
	             WHEN c.confirmstatus = 10 THEN '待承接'
	             WHEN c.type=4 and c.confirmstatus = 20 THEN '自选已承接' -- 主动承接
	             WHEN c.confirmstatus = 20 THEN '系统分配已承接' -- 主动承接
	             WHEN c.confirmstatus = 21 THEN '自动承接'
	             WHEN c.confirmstatus = 30 THEN '已拒接'
	             END AS confirmstatus,
	        g.reason AS reject_reason,
	        CASE WHEN b.approvalstatus IN (30, 40) THEN NULL
	             WHEN c.throwstatus = 0 THEN '无需执行(初始状态, 匹配失败,匹配成功待承接...)'
	             WHEN c.throwstatus = 10 THEN '待执行甩班'
	             WHEN c.throwstatus = 20 THEN '已执行甩班' END AS throwstatus,
	        CASE
	            WHEN get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy') IS NULL THEN NULL
	            WHEN lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy'))) = 'null' THEN NULL
	            WHEN trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy')) = '' THEN NULL
	            WHEN get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy') = 'same_city' THEN '同城分配'
	            WHEN get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy') = 'priority_same_city' THEN '优先同城'
	            WHEN get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy') = 'nationwide' THEN '全国分配'
	            ELSE get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.allocationStrategy')
	        END AS alloc_strategy_display,
	        CASE WHEN d.teacher_city = f.mentor_org_city THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_throw_takeover_same_city,
	        CASE WHEN b.throwclassdate < b.throwclassdatelatest THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_throw_early_effective,-- 实际生效日期早于最晚生效日期
	        CASE
	            WHEN e.stage_weekidx IS NULL OR e.stage_weekidx = '' THEN NULL
	            WHEN get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality') IS NULL THEN NULL
	            WHEN lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality'))) = 'null' THEN NULL
	            WHEN trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality')) = '' THEN NULL
	            WHEN cast(e.stage_weekidx AS int) >= 37 AND lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality'))) = 'good' THEN '续费好班'
	            WHEN cast(e.stage_weekidx AS int) >= 37 AND lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality'))) = 'bad' THEN '续费差班'
	            WHEN cast(e.stage_weekidx AS int) < 37 AND lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality'))) = 'good' THEN '完课好班'
	            WHEN cast(e.stage_weekidx AS int) < 37 AND lower(trim(get_json_object(c.matchinfo, '$.classQuality'))) = 'bad' THEN '完课差班'
	            ELSE NULL
	        END AS class_layer_type_display,
	        COALESCE(h.is_takeover_same_progress_class, 0) AS is_takeover_has_same_progress_class,
	        grp_exp.class_ids AS throw_class_group_class_ids,
	        tgp.is_throw_group_pack_assign_ok,
	        CASE
	            WHEN grp_exp.group_quality IS NULL THEN NULL
	            WHEN lower(trim(grp_exp.group_quality)) = 'null' THEN NULL
	            WHEN trim(grp_exp.group_quality) = '' THEN NULL
	            WHEN lower(trim(grp_exp.group_quality)) = 'good' THEN '好班组'
	            WHEN lower(trim(grp_exp.group_quality)) = 'bad' THEN '差班组'
	            ELSE NULL
	        END AS throw_class_group_layer_display,
			row_number()over(partition by b.classid ORDER BY fenpei_time desc) AS fenpei_rk

	FROM
	(-- 甩班申请记录表
		SELECT  applicant,-- 甩班申请人ldap
		        reason,
		        dbctime,
		        id
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_application_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
		GROUP BY  applicant,
		          reason,
		          dbctime,
		          id
	) a
	JOIN
	(-- 甩班请求凭证表
		SELECT  id,
				classid,
				subject,
		        applicant,
		        from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdatelatest,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdatelatest, -- 甩班最晚生效日期
		        from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdate, -- 实际甩班生效日期(接班老师可申请调整甩班生效日期)
		        assigneeldap, -- 接班老师ldap
		        approvalstatus, -- 关联的甩班申请审批状态
		        matchstatus, -- 甩班请求匹配状态
		        latestmatchrecordid, -- 最新的甩班匹配记录id(throw_class_match_record表的主键)
		        throwclassapplicationid,
		        throwclasstype,
		        to_date(dbctime) AS dbctime
		FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_request_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
		AND {{from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}
		GROUP BY  id,classid,subject,
		          applicant,
		          from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdatelatest,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		          from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd'),
		          assigneeldap,
		          approvalstatus,
		          matchstatus,
		          latestmatchrecordid,
		          throwclassapplicationid,
		          throwclasstype,
		          to_date(dbctime)
	) b
	ON a.applicant = b.applicant AND a.id = b.throwclassapplicationid
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  classid,
		        type,
		        throwclassrequestid,
		        assigneeldap,
		        confirmstatus,
		        allocate_dt,
		        fenpei_time,
		        throwstatus,
		        matchinfo
		FROM
		(-- 甩班匹配单据表
			SELECT  id,
					type,
			        throwclassmatchtaskid,
          			throwclassrequestid,
			        classid,
			        assigneeldap,
			        confirmstatus,
			        from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS throwclassdate,
			        to_date(dbctime) AS allocate_dt,
			        dbctime as fenpei_time,
			        throwstatus,
			        matchinfo,
			        row_number()over(partition by throwclassmatchtaskid,classid,assigneeldap ORDER BY cast(id as int) desc) AS rk
			FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_throw_class_match_record_da
			WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
			AND {{from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}
			GROUP BY  id,
					  type,
			          throwclassmatchtaskid,
          			  throwclassrequestid,
			          classid,
			          assigneeldap,
			          confirmstatus,
			          from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(throwclassdate,'yyyyMMdd'),'yyyy-MM-dd'),
			          to_date(dbctime),
			          dbctime,
			          throwstatus,
			          matchinfo
		)a
		WHERE {{allocate_dt}}
		AND rk = 1 
	) c
	ON b.classid = c.classid  and b.id=c.throwclassrequestid
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  class_id AS classid,
		        stage_name,
		        stage_week_idx AS stage_weekidx,
		        week_dt,
		        teacher_ldap,
		        team_leader_ldap AS teacher_leader_ldap,
		        teacher_city,
		        district_leader_ldap,
		        COUNT(distinct user_id) AS user_num
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
		GROUP BY  class_id,
		          stage_name,
		          stage_week_idx,
		          week_dt,
		          teacher_ldap,
		          team_leader_ldap,
		          teacher_city,
		          district_leader_ldap
	)d
	ON b.classid = d.classid AND date_sub(next_day(b.dbctime, 'MO'), 7) = d.week_dt
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  class_id AS classid,
		        stage_week_idx AS stage_weekidx,
		        week_dt
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
		GROUP BY  class_id,
		          stage_week_idx,
		          week_dt
	)e
	ON b.classid = e.classid AND date_sub(next_day(b.throwclassdate, 'MO'), 7) = e.week_dt
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  mentor_ldap,
		        team_leader_ldap,
		        district_leader_ldap,
		        mentor_org_city
		FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da
		WHERE dt = '{{{end_date}}}'
		GROUP BY  mentor_ldap,
		          team_leader_ldap,
		          district_leader_ldap,
		          mentor_org_city
	) f
	ON c.assigneeldap = f.mentor_ldap
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  teacher_ldap,
		        week_dt,
		        subject_id,

file_content:
WITH detail AS
(
	SELECT  start_class_dt,
	        is_bundled,
	        end_class_dt,
	        user_id,
	        is_renewal,
	        renewal_order_pay_dt,
	        renewal_rhythm,
	        renew_cnt,
	        all_fin,
	        w1d1_fin,
	        w1d2_fin,
	        w1d3_fin,
	        w1d4_fin,
	        w2d1_fin,
	        w2d2_fin,
	        w2d3_fin,
	        w2d4_fin,
	        CASE WHEN w1_attend_end = 1 AND w2_attend_end = 0 THEN '仅W1参加'
	             WHEN w1_attend_end = 0 AND w2_attend_end = 1 THEN '仅W2参加'
	             WHEN w1_attend_end = 1 AND w2_attend_end = 1 THEN 'W1+W2参加'  ELSE '未参加' END AS att_type,
	        CASE WHEN w1_finish_end = 1 AND w2_finish_end = 0 THEN '仅W1完成'
	             WHEN w1_finish_end = 0 AND w2_finish_end = 1 THEN '仅W2完成'
	             WHEN w1_finish_end = 1 AND w2_finish_end = 1 THEN 'W1+W2完成'  ELSE '未完成' END AS fin_type,
	        exam_score,
	        question_cnt
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
		        is_bundled,
		        a.end_class_dt,
		        a.user_id,
		        is_renewal,
		        renewal_order_pay_dt,
		        renewal_rhythm,
		        renew_cnt,
		        all_fin,
		        w1d1_fin,
		        w1d2_fin,
		        w1d3_fin,
		        w1d4_fin,
		        w2d1_fin,
		        w2d2_fin,
		        w2d3_fin,
		        w2d4_fin,
		        SUM(if(finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,exam_score,0)) AS exam_score,
		        SUM(if(finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,question_cnt,0)) AS question_cnt,
		        MAX(if(b.week_idx = 1 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w1_attend_end,
		        MAX(if(b.week_idx = 2 AND attend_status > 0 AND first_enter_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w2_attend_end,
		        MAX(if(b.week_idx = 1 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w1_finish_end,
		        MAX(if(b.week_idx = 2 AND finish_status > 0 AND finish_exam_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0)) AS w2_finish_end
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        is_bundled,
			        start_class_dt,
			        semester_id,
			        is_renewal,
			        renewal_rhythm,
			        end_class_dt,
			        renewal_order_pay_dt,
			        parent_semester_id
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND subject_id IN (2)
			AND stage_name = 'S4'
			AND semester_label != '虚拟' 
		)a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        parent_semester_id,
			        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,renewal_order_id,null)) AS renew_cnt
			FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			GROUP BY  user_id,
			          parent_semester_id
		)t
		ON a.user_id = t.user_id AND a.parent_semester_id = t.parent_semester_id
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  userid,
			        week_idx,
			        semester_id,
			        mission_id
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_mission_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND is_test = '0'
			AND {{start_class_dt}}
			AND semester_type_cd = 'try_double'
			AND subject_id = 2
			AND stage_name = 'S4'
			AND day_idx = 5
			AND mission_type_cd = '19' 
		) b
		ON a.user_id = b.userid AND a.semester_id = b.semester_id
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
			        exam_source_id,
			        user_id,
			        week_num,
			        show_dt,
			        MAX(finish_status) AS finish_status,
			        MAX(attend_status) AS attend_status,
			        MIN(first_enter_dt) AS first_enter_dt,
			        MIN(finish_exam_dt) AS finish_exam_dt,
			        MAX(exam_score) AS exam_score,
			        MAX(question_cnt) AS question_cnt
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_exam_report_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND subject_id = 2
			AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}}
			AND exam_type = '1001'
			AND stage_id = '204'
			AND exam_resource_finish_rk = 1
			GROUP BY  regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-'),
			          exam_source_id,
			          user_id,
			          week_num,
			          show_dt
		)c
		ON a.start_class_dt = c.start_class_dt AND a.user_id = c.user_id AND b.mission_id = c.exam_source_id
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        semester_id,
			        if(all_rec_cnt > 0 AND all_rec_cnt = all_fin_cnt,1,0) AS all_fin,
			        if(w1d1_rec > 0 AND w1d1_rec = w1d1_fin,1,0) AS w1d1_fin,
			        if(w1d2_rec > 0 AND w1d2_rec = w1d2_fin,1,0) AS w1d2_fin,
			        if(w1d3_rec > 0 AND w1d3_rec = w1d3_fin,1,0) AS w1d3_fin,
			        if(w1d4_rec > 0 AND w1d4_rec = w1d4_fin,1,0) AS w1d4_fin,
			        if(w2d1_rec > 0 AND w2d1_rec = w2d1_fin,1,0) AS w2d1_fin,
			        if(w2d2_rec > 0 AND w2d2_rec = w2d2_fin,1,0) AS w2d2_fin,
			        if(w2d3_rec > 0 AND w2d3_rec = w2d3_fin,1,0) AS w2d3_fin,
			        if(w2d4_rec > 0 AND w2d4_rec = w2d4_fin,1,0) AS w2d4_fin
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        semester_id,
				        COUNT(distinct mission_id) AS all_rec_cnt,
				        COUNT(distinct if(is_fin = 1,mission_id,null)) AS all_fin_cnt,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d1_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 2,mission_id,null)) AS w1d2_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 3,mission_id,null)) AS w1d3_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 4,mission_id,null)) AS w1d4_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d1_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 2,mission_id,null)) AS w2d2_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 3,mission_id,null)) AS w2d3_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 4,mission_id,null)) AS w2d4_rec,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 1 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d1_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 2 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d2_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 3 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d3_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 1 AND day_idx = 4 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w1d4_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 1 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d1_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 2 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d2_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 3 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d3_fin,
				        COUNT(distinct if(stage_week_idx = 2 AND day_idx = 4 AND is_finished_cur_day = 1,mission_id,null)) AS w2d4_fin
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  user_id,
					        semester_id,
					        stage_week_idx,
					        day_idx,
					        mission_id,
					        if(is_finished = 1 AND first_finish_dt <= end_class_dt,1,0) AS is_fin,
					        is_finished_cur_day,
					        is_attend_cur_day
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_user_mission_finish_data_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
					AND semester_type_cd IN ('try', 'try_double', 'try_refer')
					AND {{start_class_dt}} 
				) a
				GROUP BY  user_id,
				          semester_id
			) a
		) d
		ON a.user_id = d.user_id AND a.semester_id = d.semester_id
		GROUP BY  a.start_class_dt,
		          is_bundled,
		          a.end_class_dt,
		          a.user_id,
		          is_renewal,
		          renewal_order_pay_dt,
		          renewal_rhythm,
		          renew_cnt,
		          all_fin,
		          w1d1_fin,
		          w1d2_fin,
		          w1d3_fin,
		          w1d4_fin,
		          w2d1_fin,
		          w2d2_fin,
		          w2d3_fin,
		          w2d4_fin
	)a
)
SELECT  start_class_dt AS `开课期次`,
        is_bundled AS `是否联带`,
        att_type AS `是否参加周测`,
        fin_type AS `是否完成周测`,
        COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `用户数`,
        SUM(exam_score)/SUM(question_cnt) AS `周测分数`,
        SUM(renew_cnt)/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `人科转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `思维总转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W0' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W0转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D1' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D1转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D2' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D2转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D3' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D3转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D4' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D4转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D5' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D5转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D6' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D6转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W1D7' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D7转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D1' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D1转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D2' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D2转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D3' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D3转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D4' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D4转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D5' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D5转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D6' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D6转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(renewal_rhythm = 'W2D7' AND is_renewal = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D7转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt > end_class_dt,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `结课后转化率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w1d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W1D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d1_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D1完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d2_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D2完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d3_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D3完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(w2d4_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `W2D4完课率`,
        COUNT(distinct if(all_fin = 1,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D7完课率`,

        COUNT(distinct if(is_renewal = 1 AND renewal_order_pay_dt <= end_class_dt,user_id,null))/COUNT(distinct user_id) AS `截止W2D7转化率`
FROM detail
GROUP BY  start_class_dt,
          is_bundled,

SELECT a.week_dt, a.subject,
 if(a.subject = 1 AND a.stage_name IN ('S3', 'S4', 'S5') AND is_shougou = '非首购', 
    concat(a.stage_name, '-', is_shougou, '-', is_neat),

    , count(distinct a.userid) AS `当周在班人数`
    , sum(finished_cur_week_mission_num) as `当周完成mission数`
    , sum(finished_cur_week_mission_num)/( 4 * count(distinct a.userid) ) as `完课率`
    , count(distinct if(b.userid is not null,a.userid,null)) as  `在班应参考人数`
    , count(distinct if(is_attend_official_exam = 1,a.userid,null)) as  `按时参考人数`
    , count(distinct if(is_attend_official_exam = 1,a.userid,null))/count(distinct if(b.userid is not null,a.userid,null))  as `按时参考率`
   
    FROM (
        SELECT user_id as userid, week_dt
            , received_mission_num
            , finished_cur_week_mission_num
            , subject_id as subject
            , stage_name
            , cast(stage_week_idx as int) as stage_weekidx
            , if(is_first_purchase_user=1,'首购','非首购') AS is_shougou
            , teacher_city
            , if(int(left_week_num + stage_week_idx) IN (48, 96, 144, 192, 240), '课时齐', '课时不齐') AS is_neat
        FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
        WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date,1)
            AND {{week_dt}}
            AND subject_id IN (1, 2, 3)
            and received_mission_num>0
    ) a
    left  join(
        SELECT  subject_id as subject,
            stage_name,
            month_num,
            cast(week_num as int) as week_num,
            is_attend_official_exam,
            show_dt,
            date_sub(next_day(show_dt, 'MO'), 7) as week_dt,
            user_id as userid
        from dw_dwd.dwd_conan_course_user_periodical_exam_da
        where dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
              and month_num is not null
              and subject_id in  ('1','2','3')
              and  {{date_sub(next_day(show_dt, 'MO'), 7) as week_dt}}
        )b
on a.subject = b.subject 
and a.stage_name = b.stage_name 
and a.userid = b.userid
and a.week_dt = b.week_dt

GROUP BY a.week_dt, a.subject,
 if(a.subject = 1 AND a.stage_name IN ('S3', 'S4', 'S5') AND is_shougou = '非首购', 
    concat(a.stage_name, '-', is_shougou, '-', is_neat),

 ,stage_weekidx,teacher_city

file_content:
--英语 
--uid、体验课模式（双周、中价）、系统课订单id、系统课订单来源、成单金额、购买系统课日期
SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
        a.userid,
        CASE WHEN semester_tag LIKE '%C%' or lesson_id=800 THEN '中价独立分班'  ELSE '英语单带双周' END AS semester_tag,
        coalesce(n.order_id,m.order_id) AS order_id,
        coalesce(n.season_from,m.season_from) AS season_from,
        coalesce(n.pay_amt,m.pay_amt) AS pay_amt,
        coalesce(n.pay_dt,m.pay_dt) AS pay_dt
FROM
(
	SELECT  userid,
	        semesterid,
	        classid,
	        teacherid,
	        orderid,
	        start_class_dt,
	        refund_dt,
	        refund_tp,
	        end_class_dt,
	        semester_tag,
  lesson_id
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  a.userid,
		        a.semesterid,
		        a.classid,
		        a.teacherid,
		        a.orderid,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        refund_dt,
		        refund_tp,
		        end_class_dt,
		        semester_tag,
      lesson_id,
		        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.userid,a.start_class_dt ORDER BY  coalesce(refund_dt,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
		FROM
		( -- 订单 表
			SELECT  b.*,
			        orderid
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  orderid,
				        userid,
				        id
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
				WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
			) a
			JOIN
			( -- 分班 表
				SELECT  userid,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
				        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
				AND lessonid IN ('126','800')
				AND type = 1
				AND status <> 3
				AND {{from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt}} 
			) b
			ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
		) a
		JOIN
		(
			SELECT  semester_id,
			        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
			        end_class_dt,
			        parent_semester_id,
			        start_stage_name,
          lesson_id
			FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
			AND subject_id = 1
			AND is_bundled = 0 
		)s
		ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
		LEFT JOIN
		( -- 退款 表
			SELECT  order_id,
			        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
			        refund_tp,
			        refundment_type_name,
			        refundment_reason
			FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
			WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
			AND refund_status_code = 2
			AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
		) b
		ON a.orderid = b.order_id
	)a
	WHERE rk = 1
	AND refund_dt is not null 
)a
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  userid,
	        classid,
	        MIN(createdtime) AS enter_class_time
	FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_receipt_user_assign_class_log_da
	WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
	GROUP BY  userid,
	          classid
)t
ON a.userid = t.userid AND a.classid = t.classid
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  user_id,
	        order_id,
	        pay_dt,
	        subject_id,
	        pay_tp,
	        first_refund_tp,
	        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
	        refund_related_weekcount,
	        pay_amt,
	        CASE WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%banmatmall%' THEN '天猫'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-xcx%' or keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-app%' THEN '召回直播'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-sph%' THEN '召回视频号'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'referral-yxzz_live-%' THEN '0转正直播间'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'cxc-yxzz_live-%' THEN '长续长直播间'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'app-live-%' THEN 'app营销直播间'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-jdkechengpop%' THEN '京东电商'
	             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-douyin%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dy%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dyxd%' THEN '抖音电商'  ELSE '其他' END AS season_from
	FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
	WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
	AND semester_type IN ('season')
	AND order_status >= 2
	AND subject_id = 1 
)n
ON a.userid = n.user_id AND n.pay_tp < a.refund_tp AND n.pay_tp > t.enter_class_time AND n.pay_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt, 7) AND (n.first_refund_tp is null or n.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or n.first_refund_dt > date_add(end_class_dt, 14))
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  user_id,
	        order_id,
	        season_from,
	        pay_amt,
	        pay_dt,
	        subject_id,
	        pay_tp,
	        first_refund_tp,
	        first_refund_dt,
	        refund_related_weekcount
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,
		        from_unixtime(int(first_refund_tp/1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS first_refund_dt,
		        refund_related_weekcount,
		        pay_amt,
		        CASE WHEN keyfrom LIKE '%banmatmall%' THEN '天猫'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-xcx%' or keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-app%' THEN '召回直播'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'zhaohui-live-sph%' THEN '召回视频号'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'referral-yxzz_live-%' THEN '0转正直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'cxc-yxzz_live-%' THEN '长续长直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'app-live-%' THEN 'app营销直播间'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-jdkechengpop%' THEN '京东电商'
		             WHEN keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-douyin%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dy%' or keyfrom LIKE 'tansuo2-dyxd%' THEN '抖音电商'  ELSE '其他' END AS season_from
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
		WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
		AND semester_type IN ('season')
		AND order_status >= 2
		AND subject_id = 1 
	) a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  renewal_order_id as renewal_orderid
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		AND subject_id = 1
		AND is_renewal = 1 
	)b
	ON a.order_id = b.renewal_orderid
	WHERE b.renewal_orderid is null 
)m
ON a.userid = m.user_id AND m.pay_tp > a.refund_tp AND m.pay_dt <= date_add(a.end_class_dt, 7) AND (m.first_refund_tp is null or m.refund_related_weekcount <= 0 or m.first_refund_dt > date_add(end_class_dt, 14))
WHERE n.order_id is not null or m.order_id is not null

  count(distinct if(success_interview_cnt=4,ab.userid,null)) as `累计阶段总结成功沟通4次人数`,

  count(distinct if(u2_u3_success_interview_cnt >0,ab.userid,null)) as `所在U阶段总结成功沟通人数`

  select a.userid,

        stage_weekidx,

        teacher_leader_ldap,
        district_leader_ldap,
        if(b.userid is not null,1,0) as is_xueqing_interview,
        success_interview_cnt 
  from
  (
  select 
            subject_id as subject,
            order_id as orderid,
            class_id as classid,
            period_type,
            regexp_replace(Split(period_type,'-')[1],'/','-') AS start_dt,

            stage_name,
            week_dt,
            cast(stage_week_idx as int) as stage_weekidx,

            user_id as userid,
            teacher_city,
            teacher_ldap,
            team_leader_ldap as teacher_leader_ldap,
            district_leader_ldap

  where  dt = date_sub(current_date,1)
            and {{subject_id as subject}}
            and {{week_dt}}
            and {{regexp_replace(Split(period_type,'-')[1],'/','-') AS start_dt}}

        -- and date_sub(next_day(created_date,'MO'),7) <= '{{{week_dt}}}'

        and cast(interview_week as int) <= '{{{stage_weekidx}}}'

  on b.subject = a.subject and b.userid = a.userid 
  -- and a.week_dt >= b.interview_week_dt 
  and a.stage_name = b.stage_name
    )ab
  left join(

  select
        userid,
        subject,
        stage_name,
        ceil(interview_week/4) as interview_u,
       
        count(distinct if(communication_status = '2',interview_id,null)) as u2_u3_success_interview_cnt

        dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
        and {{subject}}
     
        and (communication_reasons_desc rlike '阶段总结' or 
        (communication_reasons_desc rlike '续报' and progress = '10'))
    
        and  ceil(interview_week/4) = ceil('{{{stage_weekidx}}}'/4)
      group by userid,
        subject,
        stage_name,
        ceil(interview_week/4) 

  )c
  on c.subject = ab.subject and c.userid = ab.userid  and ab.stage_name = c.stage_name


  group by  ab.week_dt,
  ab.stage_weekidx,
  ab.subject,
  ab.period_type,

  ab.stage_name,
  ab.classid,
  ab.teacher_city,
  ab.teacher_ldap,
  ab.teacher_leader_ldap,
  ab.district_leader_ldap

    ,count(distinct user_id) as `曝光人数`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt < a.min_show_dt, concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `体验课T-1（首次曝光前一天）`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt <= a.min_show_dt, concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T0（首次曝光日）`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,3), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T3`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,7), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T7`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,14), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T14`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type != 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,30), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T30`

    -- 系统课
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt < a.min_show_dt, concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `系统课T-1（首次曝光前一天）`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt <= a.min_show_dt, concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T0（首次曝光日）`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,3), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T3`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,7), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T7`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,14), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T14`
    ,count(distinct if(semester_type = 'season' and pay_dt <= date_add(a.min_show_dt,30), concat(subject_id, '-', user_id), null)) as `T30`

from  
(
    
select
    a.min_show_dt

    ,a.exp_name
    ,a.exp_group_name
    ,a.user_id

    ,b.subject_id
    ,b.semester_type
from  
(
select

    ,nvl(split(experimentinfo, '_')[1], '无实验') as exp_name
    ,nvl(split(experimentinfo, '_')[2], '无实验') as exp_group_name
    ,min(show_dt) as min_show_dt
    -- ,resource_type
    -- ,user_group_type
    -- ,ab_test_group
    -- ,material_channel
    -- , case when material_channel='5' then '扩科'
    --  when material_channel='12' then '投放'
    --  when material_channel='0' then '百科-默认'
    --  when material_channel='6' then '召回'
    --  when material_channel='7' then '流量池'
    --  when material_channel='11' then '自然流量'
    --  when material_channel='13' then '百科'
    --  when material_channel='14' then '南瓜投放扩科'
    --  when material_channel='15' then '百科投放扩科'
    --  when material_channel='16' then '主题课'
    --  else material_channel end as ad_channel
    -- ,lesson_group_id
    -- ,recommend_lesson_name
    -- ,action_type
    -- ,user_id
    -- ,order_id
    -- ,request_id
    -- ,experimentinfo
    -- ,nvl(split(experimentinfo, '_')[1], '无实验') as exp_name
    -- ,nvl(split(experimentinfo, '_')[2], '无实验') as exp_group_name
from
    dw_dwd.dwd_conan_mkt_kuoke_action_di
where
    
     dt >= '{{{start_dt}}}'
    and show_dt >= '{{{start_dt}}}'
    and show_dt <= '{{{end_dt}}}'
  and dt <= date_add('{{{end_dt}}}',7)
    and  1=1 
    and  1=1 
    and  1=1 
    and  1=1 
    and  1=1 
    and lesson_group_id != 0
    and action_type = 'show'
    and {{nvl(split(experimentinfo, '_')[1], '无实验') as exp_name}} --= '0元扩科实验v2' -- ，0元扩思维V2

group by

        from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da

        -- group by

)b  
on a.user_id = b.user_id
)a 
group by
    exp_name
    ,exp_group_name
    ,dt_monday
with cube
order by
    exp_name
    ,exp_group_name
    ,dt_monday

    ,count(distinct if(b.exam_resource_finish_rk = 1 and b.is_right = 1,concat(b.user_id,b.exam_source_id,b.question_id),null)) as first_right_cnt
    ,round(count(distinct if(b.exam_resource_finish_rk = 1 and b.is_right = 1,concat(b.user_id,b.exam_source_id,b.question_id),null))*100/count(distinct concat(b.user_id,b.exam_source_id,b.question_id)),2) as first_right_rt
    ,round(percentile_approx((b.question_answer_duration/1000),0.5),2) as answer_time_mid
    ,round(percentile_approx(if(b.exam_resource_finish_rk = 1,(b.question_answer_duration/1000),null),0.5),2) as first_answer_time_mid
from
    (select user_id
        ,week_num
        ,exam_source_id
        ,if(exam_type = 1001,'周测','月测') as exam_type
    from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_exam_report_da 
    where dt = date_sub(current_date,1)
        and stage_id = 107
        and exam_type in (1001,1002)
        and {{regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') as start_class_dt}}
        and {{week_num}}
    group by user_id,week_num,exam_source_id,if(exam_type = 1001,'周测','月测')
    ) a 
join
    (select user_id
        ,exam_source_id
        ,exam_schedule
        ,question_id
        ,is_right
        ,question_score
        ,question_answer_duration
        ,exam_resource_finish_rk
        ,case when skill_type_cd = 0 then '无'
              when skill_type_cd = 1 then '听'
              when skill_type_cd = 2 then '说'
              when skill_type_cd = 3 then '读'
              when skill_type_cd = 4 then '写'
              when skill_type_cd = 5 then '自然拼读'
              when skill_type_cd = 6 then '斑马力'
              when skill_type_cd = 7 then '词汇'
              when skill_type_cd = 8 then '语法'
              when skill_type_cd = 9 then '视'
              when skill_type_cd = 10 then '音标'
              when skill_type_cd = 11 then '语音策略'
              else skill_type_cd end as skill_type_cd
        ,kp_map['skill_level'] as skill_level
        ,kp_map['name'] as keypoint_name
    from dw_dwd.dwd_eng_course_exam_question_report_da
    lateral view explode(keypoints) kp_table as kp_map

             question_answer_duration,exam_resource_finish_rk,skill_type_cd,
             kp_map['skill_level'],kp_map['name']
    ) b
    on a.user_id = b.user_id and a.exam_source_id = b.exam_source_id
group by exam_type,exam_schedule,question_id,skill_type_cd,skill_level,keypoint_name

--体验课的用户标签收集情况
WITH user_all AS
(
	SELECT  class_mode,
	        start_class_dt,
	        user_id,
	        parent_semester_id,
	        teacher_ldap,
	        is_renewal
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  CASE WHEN is_bundled = '联带' THEN '英思联带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 800 THEN '英语中价'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 126 THEN '英语单带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' END AS class_mode,
		        start_class_dt,
		        user_id,
		        parent_semester_id,
		        teacher_ldap,
		        MAX(is_renewal) AS is_renewal
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND {{start_class_dt}}
		AND semester_label != '虚拟'
		GROUP BY  CASE WHEN is_bundled = '联带' THEN '英思联带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 800 THEN '英语中价'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 1 AND lesson_id = 126 THEN '英语单带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 2 THEN '思维单带'
		             WHEN is_bundled = '单带' AND subject_id = 3 THEN '阅读单带' END,
		          start_class_dt,
		          user_id,
		          parent_semester_id,
		          teacher_ldap
		UNION ALL
		SELECT  CASE WHEN subject_id = 4 THEN '美术'
		             WHEN subject_id = 5 THEN '写字'
		             WHEN subject_id = 7 THEN '音乐'
		             WHEN subject_id = 8 THEN '科学' END AS class_mode,
		        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
		        user_id,
		        parent_semester_id,
		        teacher_ldap,
		        MAX(is_renewal) AS is_renewal
		FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_art_try_user_quality_detail_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-')[1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}}
		GROUP BY  CASE WHEN subject_id = 4 THEN '美术'
		             WHEN subject_id = 5 THEN '写字'
		             WHEN subject_id = 7 THEN '音乐'
		             WHEN subject_id = 8 THEN '科学' END,
		          regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-')[1],'\\/','\\-'),
		          user_id,
		          parent_semester_id,
		          teacher_ldap
	)a
	JOIN
	(
		SELECT  distinct userid,
		        semesterid
		FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_user_mentor_interview_try_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
		AND communication_reasons_desc = '参课沟通'
		AND validation = 1 
	)b
	ON a.user_id = b.userid AND a.parent_semester_id = b.semesterid
)
SELECT  a.class_mode AS `业务模式`,
        a.start_class_dt AS `期数`,
        a.is_renewal AS `是否转化`,
        all_user AS `全部用户数`,
        a.label_category_show_name AS `标签类型`,
        user_cnt AS `用户数`
FROM
(
	SELECT  a.class_mode,
	        a.start_class_dt,
	        is_renewal,
	        label_category_show_name,
	        COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS user_cnt
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  distinct a.class_mode,
		        a.start_class_dt,
		        a.is_renewal,
		        a.user_id,
		        coalesce(label_category_show_name,'无标签') AS label_category_show_name
		FROM user_all a
		LEFT JOIN
		(
			SELECT  a.class_mode,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        a.user_id,
			        a.teacher_ldap,
			        a.parent_semester_id,
			        a.is_renewal,
			        label_category_show_name
			FROM user_all a
			JOIN
			(
				SELECT  parent_semester_id,
				        stage_name,
				        CASE WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try_double' AND concat_subject = '1' THEN concat('英语',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try_double' AND concat_subject = '2' THEN concat('思维',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try_double' AND concat_subject = '3' THEN concat('阅读',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try' AND concat_subject = '4' THEN concat('美术',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try' AND concat_subject = '5' THEN concat('写字',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try' AND concat_subject = '7' THEN concat('音乐',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try' AND concat_subject = '8' THEN concat('科学',stage_name)
				             WHEN semester_type_cd = 'try_double' AND concat_subject = '1,2' THEN concat('英',substring(stage_name,0,2),'思',substring(stage_name,4,2))  ELSE 'other' END AS label_stage_name
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  parent_semester_id,
					        semester_type_cd,
					        concat_ws(',',sort_array(collect_list(start_stage_name))) AS stage_name,
					        concat_ws(',',sort_array(collect_list(subject_id))) AS concat_subject
					FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
					GROUP BY  parent_semester_id,
					          semester_type_cd
				) a
				WHERE concat_subject IN ('1', '2', '3', '1,2', '4', '5', '7', '8') 
			) b
			ON a.parent_semester_id = b.parent_semester_id
			JOIN
			(
				SELECT  distinct user_id,
				        top_label_show_name AS label_one_class_show_name,
				        second_label_show_name AS label_second_class_show_name,
				        third_label_show_name AS label_category_show_name
				FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_conan_service_peace_task_user_label_new_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				AND is_fourth_valid = '1'
				AND is_third_valid = '1'
				AND is_second_valid = '1'
				AND lesson_type = 'experience'
				AND top_label_show_name != '转化影响因素'
				AND third_label_show_name != '年龄' 
			) c
			ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND (c.label_second_class_show_name = '通用' or c.label_second_class_show_name = b.label_stage_name) --对应学科展示
			UNION ALL
			SELECT  a.class_mode,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        a.user_id,
			        a.teacher_ldap,
			        a.parent_semester_id,
			        a.is_renewal,
			        label_category_show_name
			FROM user_all a
			JOIN
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        ldap,
				        '昵称' AS label_category_show_name
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_mentor_profile_user_teacher_note_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
			)b
			ON a.user_id = b.userid AND a.teacher_ldap = b.ldap
			UNION ALL
			SELECT  a.class_mode,
			        a.start_class_dt,
			        a.user_id,
			        a.teacher_ldap,
			        a.parent_semester_id,
			        a.is_renewal,
			        label_category_show_name
			FROM user_all a
			JOIN
			(
				SELECT  userid,
				        '年龄' AS label_category_show_name
				FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_english_profile_profile_da
				WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
				AND birthday > 0 
			)b
			ON a.user_id = b.userid
		)b
		ON a.class_mode = b.class_mode AND a.start_class_dt = b.start_class_dt AND a.user_id = b.user_id
	)a
	GROUP BY  a.class_mode,
	          a.start_class_dt,
	          is_renewal,
	          label_category_show_name
)a
LEFT JOIN
(
	SELECT  a.class_mode,
	        a.start_class_dt,
	        is_renewal,
	        COUNT(distinct a.user_id) AS all_user
	FROM user_all a
  GROUP BY  a.class_mode,
	          a.start_class_dt,
	          is_renewal
)b
ON a.class_mode = b.class_mode AND a.start_class_dt = b.start_class_dt AND a.is_renewal = b.is_renewal

--阅读中价退费情况
WITH detail AS
(
	SELECT  a.start_class_dt,
	        s.end_class_dt,
	        a.user_id,
	        a.lesson_id,
	        MAX(a.stage_name) AS stage_name,
	        MAX(age_buy_lesson_type) AS age_buy_lesson_type,
	        MAX(a.pay_dt) AS pay_dt,
	        MAX(s.parent_semester_id) AS parent_semester_id,
	        MAX(s.semester_tag) AS semester_tag,
	        MAX(refund_dt) AS refund_dt,
	        MIN(if(is_finish_end = 1,1,0)) AS is_finish_end,
	        MAX(if(m.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_after_season,
	        MAX(if(n.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_before_season,
	        MAX(validation) AS validation,
	        MAX(if(is_gou = 1,1,0)) AS is_gou,
	        MAX(j.end_class_dt) AS pre_end_class_dt,
	        MAX(if(f.user_id is not null,1,0)) AS is_live
	FROM
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        semesterid,
		        a.lesson_id,
		        start_class_dt,
		        order_id,
		        stage_name,
		        parent_order_id,
		        subject_id,
		        keyfrom,
		        refund_dt,
		        refund_tp,
		        pay_dt,
		        pay_tp,
		        age_buy_lesson_type,
		        ad_channel,
		        classid,
		        teacherid,
		        ldap,
		        is_finish_end,
		        is_season
		FROM
		(
			SELECT  user_id,
			        order_id,
			        a.lesson_id,
			        stage_name,
			        pay_dt,
			        pay_tp,
			        subject_id,
			        parent_order_id,
			        keyfrom,
			        order_status,
			        start_class_dt,
			        age_buy_lesson_type,
			        ad_channel,
			        semesterid,
			        classid,
			        teacherid,
			        ldap,
			        refund_dt,
			        refund_tp,
			        is_finish_end,
			        is_season,
			        dt,
			        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.order_id ORDER BY  dt DESC) AS rk
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  user_id,
				        order_id,
				        a.lesson_id,
				        stage_name,
				        pay_dt,
				        pay_tp,
				        subject_id,
				        parent_order_id,
				        keyfrom,
				        order_status,
				        start_class_dt,
				        age_buy_lesson_type,
				        ad_channel,
				        semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        refund_dt,
				        refund_tp
			FROM
			(
				SELECT  a.user_id,
				        a.order_id,
				        a.lesson_id,
				        stage_name,
				        a.pay_dt,
				        a.pay_tp,
				        a.subject_id,
				        a.parent_order_id,
				        a.keyfrom,
				        a.order_status,
				        a.start_class_dt,
				        a.age_buy_lesson_type,
				        a.ad_channel,
				        b.semesterid,
				        classid,
				        teacherid,
				        ldap,
				        if(c.refund_dt is not null,c.refund_dt,null) AS refund_dt,
				        if(c.refund_tp is not null,c.refund_tp,null) AS refund_tp,
				        ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY a.user_id,a.start_class_dt,a.subject_id ORDER BY  coalesce(c.refund_dt,9999999999999) DESC) AS rk
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  a.user_id,
					        a.order_id,
					        a.lesson_id,
					        a.pay_dt,
					        a.pay_tp,
					        a.subject_id,
					        a.parent_order_id,
					        a.keyfrom,
					        a.order_status,
					        a.refund_related_weekcount,
					        a.start_class_dt,
					        age_buy_lesson_type,
					        ad_channel,
					        stage_name
				FROM
				(
					SELECT  user_id,
					        order_id,
					        pay_dt,
					        pay_tp,
					        subject_id,
					        parent_order_id,
					        keyfrom,
					        order_status,
					        refund_related_weekcount,
					        regexp_replace(split(period_type,'-') [1],'\\/','\\-') AS start_class_dt,
					        lesson_id,
					        stage_name
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_eng_order_course_detail_da
					WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
					AND semester_type IN ('try_double')
					AND subject_id = 3
					AND {{regexp_replace(split(period_type, '-') [1], '\\/', '\\-') AS start_class_dt}} 
				)a
				JOIN
				(
					SELECT  user_id,
					        order_id,
					        CASE WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 0 AND age_buy_lesson < 2 THEN '0-2岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 2 AND age_buy_lesson < 3 THEN '2-3岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 3 AND age_buy_lesson < 4 THEN '3-4岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 4 AND age_buy_lesson < 5 THEN '4-5岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 5 AND age_buy_lesson < 6 THEN '5-6岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 6 AND age_buy_lesson < 7 THEN '6-7岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 7 AND age_buy_lesson < 8 THEN '7-8岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 8 AND age_buy_lesson < 9 THEN '8-9岁'
					             WHEN age_buy_lesson >= 9 THEN '9岁以上'  ELSE '未设置' END AS age_buy_lesson_type,
					        ad_channel
					FROM dw_conan_dwd.dwd_trade_try_double_order_from_info_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
					AND ad_channel IN ('抖音中价', '腾讯中价', '其他中价', '电商中价') 
				)b
				ON a.order_id = b.order_id
				) a
				LEFT JOIN
				( -- 订单 表
					SELECT  b.*,
					        orderid,
					        ldap
					FROM
					(
						SELECT  orderid,
						        userid,
						        id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_fulfill_center_wares_fulfill_order_item_da
						WHERE dt = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1) 
					) a
					JOIN
					( -- 分班 表
						SELECT  userid,
						        semesterid,
						        classid,
						        teacherid,
						        from_unixtime(int(startclasstime / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_class_dt,
						        GET_JSON_OBJECT(allocateexpinfo,'$.fulfillOrderId') AS fulfill_order_id
						FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_allocate_teacher_student_allocate_sub_lesson_da
						WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
						AND lessonid IN ('870', '122')
						AND type = 1
						AND status <> 3 
					) b
					ON a.userid = b.userid AND b.fulfill_order_id = a.id
					LEFT JOIN
					(
						SELECT  mentor_ldap AS ldap,
						        tf.key AS teacherid
						FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_mentor_info_da lateral view explode(wechat_info) tf AS key, value
						WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
					)c
					ON b.teacherid = c.teacherid
				) b
				ON a.order_id = b.orderid
				LEFT JOIN
				( -- 退款 表
					SELECT  order_id,
					        from_unixtime(int(refund_tp / 1000),'yyyy-MM-dd') AS refund_dt,
					        refund_tp,
					        refundment_type_name
					FROM dw_dwd.dwd_conan_trade_refund_da
					WHERE dt = date_sub(CURRENT_DATE, 1)
					AND refund_status_code = 2 -- 成功
					AND refundment_type_name IN ('退课退款') 
				) c
				ON a.order_id = c.order_id
			)a
			WHERE rk = 1 
			)a
			LEFT JOIN
			(
				SELECT  user_id AS userid,
				        order_id AS orderid,
				        is_finish_end_class AS is_finish_end,
				        is_renewal AS is_season,
				        dt,
				        end_class_dt
				FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_service_try_double_user_quality_detail_da
				WHERE dt BETWEEN date_sub(start_class_dt, 21) AND date_add(end_class_dt, 14)
				AND {{start_class_dt}} 
				AND semester_label != '虚拟'
			) d
			ON a.order_id = d.orderid AND refund_dt is not null AND d.dt <= a.refund_dt
		)a
		WHERE rk = 1 
	)a
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  semester_id,
		        parent_semester_id,
		        experiment_tag AS semester_tag,
		        is_bundled,
		        subject_id AS subject,
		        end_class_dt,
		        lesson_id
		FROM dw_dim.dim_eng_semester_da
		WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
	) s
	ON a.semesterid = s.semester_id
	LEFT JOIN
	(
		SELECT  user_id,
		        order_id,
		        pay_dt,
		        subject_id,
		        pay_tp,
		        first_refund_tp,

d.subject_id,

d.week_dt,
sum(finished_cur_week_mission_num) as finished_cur_week_mission_num,
sum(received_mission_num*target*nvl(fullfinishtargetdiscount,1)) as finish_target_num

from(

SELECT  
    subject_id,
    stage_name,
    class_id,
    is_first_purchase_user,
    if(receipt_consistent_status=1,1,0) as is_consistent,
    week_dt,
    cast(stage_week_idx as int) as stage_week_idx,
    sum(received_mission_num) as received_mission_num, 
    sum(finished_cur_week_mission_num) as finished_cur_week_mission_num
    
FROM dw_conan_ads.ads_course_season_user_class_week_all_info_da
WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
AND subject_id IN ('1', '2', '3')
and week_dt >= '2025-01-06'
group by subject_id,
    stage_name,
    class_id,
    is_first_purchase_user,
    if(receipt_consistent_status=1,1,0),
    week_dt,
    cast(stage_week_idx as int) 

)d
LEFT JOIN
(
  SELECT  to_date(from_unixtime(int(validstarttime / 1000))) AS validstarttime,
          to_date(from_unixtime(int(validendtime / 1000))) AS validendtime,
          subject,
          stageid,
          week,
          first,
          receiptconsistent,
          missionfinishtarget as target
  FROM dw_ods.ods_conan_stat_data_sys_jichu_finish_target_da
  WHERE dt = date_sub(current_date, 1)
  and subject in ('1','2','3')
  
 
) e
ON d.subject_id = e.subject  
AND substr(d.stage_name, 2, 1) = substr(e.stageid, 3, 1) 
AND d.stage_week_idx = e.week
AND d.is_first_purchase_user = e.first
AND d.is_consistent = e.receiptconsistent
and d.week_dt >= validstarttime and d.week_dt<validendtime
LEFT JOIN (

select class_id,
stage_id as stageid,
finish_transition_start_week_include as fullFinishTransitionStartWeekInclude,
finish_transition_end_week_include as fullFinishTransitionEndWeekInclude,
discount as fullfinishtargetdiscount
from dw_conan_ods.ods_conan_stat_finish_sys_throw_class_finish_target_discount_da
where dt = date_sub(current_date, 1) 
and throw_start_expected_time >= 1736092800000


)f

AND substr(d.stage_name, 2, 1) = substr(f.stageid, 3, 1)
AND d.stage_week_idx >= f.fullFinishTransitionStartWeekInclude
AND d.stage_week_idx <= f.fullFinishTransitionEndWeekInclude
group by d.subject_id,
d.stage_name,
d.stage_week_idx,
d.class_id,
d.week_dt
)

    from class_target

a.week_dt,
a.period_type,
a.subject_id,
a.stage_name,

a.class_id,
a.teacher_ldap,
a.teacher_city as `老师城市`,

a.is_first_purchase_user,
if(count(distinct b.user_id) > 0, max(b.live_room_id), null) as `直播间id`,
count(distinct a.user_id) as user_cnt,

sum(valid_watch_time)/60 as valid_watch_time_min

(

SELECT

    class_id,
